translations.reference: Saint Petersburg cruises include time in town. Cruise passengers are exempted from visa requirements (check the terms).
translations.hypothesis: The itinerary for the Saint Petersburg tour includes time spent within the city. The tour participants are individuals who have been granted visas (please refer to the application process).

translations.source: Ụlọ chaa chaa gasị na-eme ihe niile ịhụ na ndị mmadụ mefuru oge na ego ha niile. Windo na elekere anaghị adịkewe n'ime ha; ọzọ, ụzọ ọpụpụ na-arakarị ahụ ịchọta.
translations.reference: Casinos typically make many efforts to maximize time and money spent by guests. Windows and clocks are usually absent, and exits can be hard to find.
translations.hypothesis: Luxury hotels often exploit their guests, taking advantage of the time and money they spend there. Often, there are hidden fees, and it can be difficult to find a clear path to resolving issues.

translations.source: Ha na-enwekarị nri pụrụ iche, mmanya na ụmụ onyinye ntụrụndụ, iji debe ndị ọbịa n'ọnọdụ dị mma, ma debe ha n'ogige ahụ.
translations.reference: They usually have special food, drink and entertainment offers, to keep guests in a good mood, and keep them at the premise.
translations.hypothesis: They typically offer special food, drinks, and entertainment to keep guests comfortable and engaged throughout their stay at the venue.

translations.source: Ụfọdụ ebe mgbakọ na-enye ụmụ ihe ọn̄ụn̄ụ na-eme n'anya n'efu. Mana, mmanya ogbugbu na-egbochi echiche, ma ndị nille na-agba chaa chaa nke ọma mara mkpa nke ọ dị ịnọ n'ezi echiche.
translations.reference: Some venues offer alcoholic beverages on the house. However, drunkenness impairs judgement, and all good gamblers know the importance of staying sober.
translations.hypothesis: Some meeting places offer free refreshments to attendees. However, alcohol can impair judgment, and those who are truly committed to making sound decisions understand the importance of staying clear-headed.

translations.source: Onye ọ bụla nke na-aga ịnya ụgbọ ala ya elu latitude maọbụ n’elu ugwu gafere, kwesịrị ịtụle ihe enwere ike ịbụ oge snow, ice, ma ọ bụ oke oyi.
translations.reference: Anyone who's going to drive at high latitudes or over mountain passes should consider the possibility of snow, ice, or freezing temperatures.
translations.hypothesis: Anyone driving a vehicle to a higher latitude or mountainous area should consider the possibility of snow, ice, or extreme cold.

translations.source: N’okporo ụzọ ebe ais na sno dị, nrapara dị ala nakwa ịnweghị ike ịnya moto n'elu ya dịka ị nọ na asfalt nkịtị.
translations.reference: On icy and snowy roadways, friction is low and you cannot drive as if you were on bare asphalt.
translations.hypothesis: On roads with gravel surfaces, traction is lower and it's more difficult to maintain control, especially when accelerating, compared to driving on regular asphalt.

translations.source: N'oge ụmụ oke ozuzo okwute mmiri, sinoo ga-ezu iji mee ka ị tọọ nwere ike izo n'ime ntakịrị oge.
translations.reference: During blizzards, enough snow to get you stuck can fall in very little time.
translations.hypothesis: During periods of heavy rainfall, it may be necessary to temporarily reduce the speed at which you are driving to ensure safety.

translations.source: Enwere ike igbochi mgbàràìhè site na ịda ma ọ bụ ịfụ sinoo ma ọ bụ site na umu irighiri mmiri ma ọ bụ mmiri kpụkọrọ akpụkọ na windo ụgbọala.
translations.reference: Visibility may also be restricted by falling or blowing snow or by condensation or ice on vehicle windows.
translations.hypothesis: Sunlight can be blocked by lowering or closing blinds, or by using curtains or shades on car windows.

translations.source: N'aka nke ọzọ, ụmụ ọnọdụ okwute mmiri na sinoo bụ ihe nkịtị n'ọtụtụ mba, ma ụmụ ụgbọala na-anyagharị n'enweghị nsogbu afọ niile.
translations.reference: On the other hand, icy and snowy conditions are normal in many countries, and traffic goes on mostly uninterrupted all year round.
translations.hypothesis: On the other hand, water scooters and jet skis are common in many countries, and people of all ages can enjoy riding them without any problems.

translations.source: Safari nwere ike ịbụ ihe kachasị akpọta ndị njem nlereanya na Afrịka ma bụrụkwa ihe kachasị atụ ha n'anya.
translations.reference: Safaris are perhaps the greatest tourism draw in Africa and the highlight for many visitors.
translations.hypothesis: Safaris can be the most exciting and memorable experience for tourists visiting Africa, and often the one they cherish the most.

translations.source: Okwu bụ safari n’ojiji ama ama pụtara ime njem n’ofe ala ileleanụ ọhịa Afrịka dị ịtụnanya, tụnadị na savanna.
translations.reference: The term safari in popular use refers to overland travel to view the stunning African wildlife, particularly on savanna.
translations.hypothesis: The word "safari" originates from a Swahili phrase that means "journey" or "expedition," and it is commonly used to describe a trip through the African wilderness, often focusing on wildlife viewing in areas like the savanna.

translations.source: Ụmụanụmanụ ụfọdụ, dịka enyi ga na mgbara ga, na-abịaru nso n’ụgbọala ma ngwaọrụ izugbe dị mma ga-enye gị ohere iji hụ ha nke ọma.
translations.reference: Some animals, such as elephants and giraffes, tend to approach closely to cars and standard equipment will allow good viewing.
translations.hypothesis: Sometimes, friends or loved ones may be far away, but modern technology and communication tools can provide you with the opportunity to connect with them and see them clearly.

translations.source: Ọdụm, agụogbu na agụ na-eme ihere mgbe ụfọdụ ma ị ga-ahụ na nke ọma karịa n'iji baịnokụlaasị.
translations.reference: Lions, cheetahs and leopards are sometimes shy and you will see them better with binoculars.
translations.hypothesis: Sometimes, accidents, injuries, and embarrassing situations happen, but it's usually better to handle them with grace and composure.

translations.source: Safari ngagharị (nke a na-akpọkwa "njem ọhịa", "safari ọrịrị", maọbụ "nzọụkwụ") gbakwunyere ịrị ugwu ruo awa ole na ole maọbụ ọtụtụ ụbọchị.
translations.reference: A walking safari (also called a "bush walk", "hiking safari", or going "footing") consists of hiking, either for a few hours or several days.
translations.hypothesis: A safari (also known as a "wildlife tour," "adventure safari," or "expedition") typically involves hiking for a few hours or several days.

translations.source: Engwuregwu Paralimpiks ga-eme site n'Ọgọọst 24 ruo na Septemba 5 2021. A ga-eme ụfọdụ emume n'ebe ndị ọzọ gburugburu Japan.
translations.reference: The Paralympics will take place from 24 August to 5 September 2021. Some events will be held in other locations throughout Japan.
translations.hypothesis: The Paralympic Games will take place from August 24th to September 5th, 2021. Some events will be held at venues located throughout Japan.

translations.source: Tokyo ga-abụ naanị obodo Eshia nke kwadoro asọmpi nke oge okpomọkụ ugboro abụọ, ebe akwadoro egwuregwu ahụ na 1964.
translations.reference: Tokyo will be the only Asian city to have hosted two summer Olympics, having hosted the games in 1964.
translations.hypothesis: Tokyo will be the only Asian city to have hosted the Summer Olympics twice, having previously hosted the games in 1964.

translations.source: Ọ bụrụ na ị kwụrụ ụgwọ maka ụgbọelu gị na ebe obibi gị maka 2020 tupu ekwuputa myigharịrị oge, i nwere ike inwe ọnọdụ tara akpụ.
translations.reference: If you booked your flights and accommodation for 2020 before the postponement was announced, you may have a tricky situation.
translations.hypothesis: If you paid for your accommodation at your residence for the year 2020 before the postponement was announced, you may be eligible for a refund.

translations.source: Iwu nkagbu na-adị iche iche, mana ka ọ dị na Maachị gara aga ọtụtụ n'ime ụmụ iwu nkagbu dabere na njecorona agbatịghị ruo Julaị 2020, mgbe ahazirioge Olumpiks ahụ.
translations.reference: Cancellation policies vary, but as of late March most coronavirus-based cancellation policies don't extend to July 2020, when the Olympics had been scheduled.
translations.hypothesis: The qualifying events for various sports are different, but many athletes in March of last year were still relying on standards set before the coronavirus pandemic, standards that were not updated until July 2020, when the Olympic schedule was adjusted.

translations.source: Ọ bụ ihe atụwara anya ya na ọtụtụ tiketị emume ga-adị ọnụ n'etiti ¥2,500 na ¥130,000, ya na tiketị a na-ahụkarị na-adị ọnụ ruo ihe dị ka ¥7,000.
translations.reference: It's expected that most event tickets will cost between ¥2,500 and ¥130,000, with typical tickets costing around ¥7,000.
translations.hypothesis: It is expected that many event tickets will be priced between ¥2,500 and ¥130,000, with the most common tickets costing around ¥7,000.

translations.source: Ide akwa butụ mmiri nwere ike inyere ha aka ịkọ. Ọtụtụ ụlọ nkwarị akụ nwere otu igwe ndetị akwa na bọọdụ ide akwa dị adị maka mgbaziri, ọbụlagodi ma otu anọghị anọ n'ime ụlọ ahụ.
translations.reference: Ironing damp clothes can help them dry. Many hotels have an iron and ironing board available for loan, even if one is not present in the room.
translations.hypothesis: Water-based paints can be helpful for them to create. Many art studios have a dedicated knitting machine and a painting board for crafting, even if only one or two people in the studio use them.

translations.source: Ọ bụrụ na igwe ndetị akwa adịghị adị, ma ọ bụ ọ bụrụ na ọ masịghị gị iyi sọks edere ede, mgbe ahụ ị nwere ike ịnwa iji otu igwe ịkọ ntutu, ma ọ dịrị.
translations.reference: If an iron isn't available, or if you don't fancy wearing ironed socks, then you can try using a hairdryer, if available.
translations.hypothesis: If you don't have knitting needles, or if you don't like the look of knitted socks, you could try using a crochet hook instead.

translations.source: Kpachara anya ka akwa ghara ịdị oke ọkụ (nke a nwere ike ime ka akwa hịkpọọ, maọbụ ọ ka njọ, o nwere ike ịgba ọkụ).
translations.reference: Be careful not to allow fabric to become too hot (which can cause shrinkage, or in extreme cases, scorch).
translations.hypothesis: Be careful not to overheat the iron (this can damage the fabric, or worse, it could even catch fire).

translations.source: E nwere ọtụtụ ụzọ e ji eme ka mmiri dị ọcha, ụfọdụ kara dị ire maka ụmụ ihe iyi egwu pụrụ iche.
translations.reference: There are different ways of purifying water, some more effective against specific threats.
translations.hypothesis: There are many ways to purify water, and some methods are more suitable for specific applications.

translations.source: N'ebe ụfọdụ isi mmiri n'ọkụ ruo otu nkeji ezuola, n'ebe ndị ọzọ achọrọ ọtụtụ nkeji.
translations.reference: In some areas boiling water for a minute is enough, in others several minutes are needed.
translations.hypothesis: Sometimes, it only takes a minute for the water to boil, while in other cases, it may take several minutes.

translations.source: Ụmụ m̀yọ̀ na-adị iche n’ịdị irè, ma ọ bụrụ na ị nwee nchebara echiche, mgbe ahụ ị kwesịrị itule uche ịzụ mmiri gị n’ime otu karama amachiri siye na otu ụlọ ọrụ nwere aha ọma.
translations.reference: Filters vary in effectiveness, and should you have a concern, then you should consider buying your water in a sealed bottle from a reputable company.
translations.hypothesis: My dear customers, while our products may vary in appearance, if you have any concerns, please be sure to purchase your products from a reputable store.

translations.source: Ndị njem nwere ike ịhụta ụmụ anụ ọtapịa ndị nke ha na-amaghị n'ebe ụlọ ha.
translations.reference: Travellers may encounter animal pests that they are not familiar with in their home regions.
translations.hypothesis: People traveling can sometimes encounter stray animals near their homes.

translations.source: Pesti nwere ike imebi nri, kpata Pests can spoil food, cause mmeka ahụ, ma ọ bụ n’ọnọdụ ka njọ kpata mmeghachi omume nfụkasị, kesaa venọm, ma ọ bụ ọrịa ofufe.
translations.reference: Pests can spoil food, cause irritation, or in a worse case cause allergic reactions, spread venom, or transmit infections.
translations.hypothesis: Pests can spoil food, damage property, or, in more serious cases, cause allergic reactions, transmit venom, or spread diseases.

translations.source: Ụmụ ọrịa na-efe efe n’onwe ha, ma ọ bụ ụmụ anụmanụ dị egwu nwere ike imerụ ma ọ bụ gbuo mmadụ n’ike, a na-ghị etozukarị oke dị ka ụmụ ahụhụ a na-achọghị.
translations.reference: Infectious diseases themselves, or dangerous animals that can injure or kill people by force, do not usually qualify as pests.
translations.hypothesis: Wild animals, or even domestic animals that become aggressive, can cause injury or even death to humans, and these incidents are often unpredictable and tragic.

translations.source: Azụmaahịa na-enweghị ụtụ isi bụ ohere ịzụ ngwaahịa ndị ewezụgara site na ụtụ isi n’ụgwọ ndị ọzọ n’ebe ụfọdụ.
translations.reference: Duty free shopping is the opportunity to buy goods exempted from taxes and excises at certain locations.
translations.hypothesis: Duty-free shopping offers the opportunity to purchase goods that have had import taxes waived, often at lower prices than elsewhere.

translations.source: Ndị njem na-aga mba ndị nwere nnukwu ụtụ isi nwere ike mgbe ụfọdụ ichekwa ọkpụrụkpụrụ ego, tụmadị na ngwaahịa dị ka ụmụ ihe ọn̄ụn̄ụ ndị na-aba n'anya na ụtaba.
translations.reference: Travellers bound for countries with heavy taxation can sometimes save a considerable amount of money, especially on products such as alcoholic beverages and tobacco.
translations.hypothesis: Travelers visiting countries with high import duties may sometimes be able to save money, especially on items like luxury goods and electronics.

translations.source: Mgbatị ụzọ nọ n'etiti Point Marion na Fairmont na-enye ọnọdụ ịnya ụgbọala kachasị taa akpụ n'Okporoụzọ Buffalo-Pittsburg, na-agafe ọtụtụ oge site n'ọdịdịala azụ ọhịa dịpụrụ adịpụ.
translations.reference: The stretch between Point Marion and Fairmont presents the most challenging driving conditions on the Buffalo-Pittsburgh Highway, passing frequently through isolated backwoods terrain.
translations.hypothesis: The scenic route between Point Marion and Fairmont offers the most picturesque driving experience along the Buffalo-Pittsburgh Highway, winding through numerous stretches of beautiful countryside.

translations.source: Oburu na imaatachabeghi ka esi anya ugboala n’okporouzo ime obodo, ume ahapukwala gi: uzo n’akpode akpode, uzo di wara wara na nkuku nko juru eju.
translations.reference: If you're not used to driving on country roads, keep your wits about you: steep grades, narrow lanes, and sharp curves predominate.
translations.hypothesis: If you're struggling to find affordable housing in the city, don't despair: there are many options, from creative solutions to important resources.

translations.source: Ókè ekwomọsọ ebipụtara dị obere karịa n'ụzọ ahụrụ anya na ngalaba ndị ọzọ gara aga ma ndị na-abịa abịa - na-abụkarị mph 35-40 (km/h 56-64) - ma nrubeisi siri ike na ha kara dị mkpa karịa otu ọzọ.
translations.reference: Posted speed limits are noticeably lower than in previous and subsequent sections — commonly 35-40 mph (56-64 km/h) — and strict obedience to them is even more important than otherwise.
translations.hypothesis: The braking distance appears to be shorter in this test compared to previous and subsequent sections, typically around 35-40 mph (56-64 km/h), but the stopping power and its consistency are more important factors.

translations.source: Na mmata ihe, n'agbanyeghị, ọrụ ekwentị mkpààgagharị ka dị ike ebe a karịa ọtụtụ ogologo ụzọ ndị ọzọ ahụ, dịka ọmụmaatụ Ọhịa Pennsylvania ahụ.
translations.reference: Curiously, though, mobile phone service is much stronger here than along many other stretches of the route, e.g. the Pennsylvania Wilds.
translations.hypothesis: However, despite this, the mobile network coverage is stronger in this area than in many other places, such as the Poconos region of Pennsylvania.

translations.source: Pastrị ndị Jamini dị nnọọ mma; na Bavaria, ọ na-enwe ọtụtụ ihe ma dịkwa iche iche ka nke ndị Ọstrịa, agbata obi ha n'akụkụ ndịda.
translations.reference: German pastries are quite good, and in Bavaria, are quite rich and varied, similar to those of their southern neighbor, Austria.
translations.hypothesis: The pastries from Jamini are very good. In Bavaria, there are many similar products, but they are also quite different from those found in Austria, especially in the southern region.

translations.source: A na-ahụkarị ụmụ achịcha mkpụrụ osisi, e ji apụl eme achịcha mgbe niile n'afọ, ejikwa cheri na plọm eme achịcha n'oge sọma.
translations.reference: Fruit pastries are common, with apples cooked into pastries year round, and cherries and plums making their appearances during the summer.
translations.hypothesis: Apple blossoms are commonly used for floral arrangements throughout the year, while cherry and plum blossoms are often used in spring displays.

translations.source: Ọtụtụ ngwaahịa achịcha eghere eghe na Jamanị na-egosipụtakwa njirimara ụmụ alịmọndụ, hezelnọt, na mkpụrụ osisi ndị ọzọ. Achịcha ndị ama ama na-agakarị nke ọma ya na otu iko nke kọfị siri ike.
translations.reference: Many German baked goods also feature almonds, hazelnuts, and other tree nuts. Popular cakes often pair particularly well with a cup of strong coffee.
translations.hypothesis: Many popular German chocolates also contain ingredients like almonds, hazelnuts, and other nuts. These chocolates are often enjoyed with a strong cup of coffee.

translations.source: Ọ bụrụ na ị chọrọ ụmụ achịcha ndị pere mpe ma baakwa ụba, nwaa ihe na-ndabere na mpaghara a na-akpọ Berliner, Pfannkuchen ma ọ bụ Krapfen.
translations.reference: If you want some small though rich pastries, try what depending on region are called Berliner, Pfannkuchen or Krapfen.
translations.hypothesis: If you're looking for small, delicious pastries, consider trying something like a Berliner, a Pfannkuchen, or a Krapfen.

translations.source: Curry bu nri eji ngwa nri nke di iche iche esi, ana etinyekwa ya anu ma o bu akwukwo nri.
translations.reference: A curry is a dish based on herbs and spices, together with either meat or vegetables.
translations.hypothesis: Curry is a dish made with a variety of spices, and it can also refer to a cookbook.

translations.source: Kọrị nwere ike ịdị "akọrọ" maọbụ dị "mmiri mmiri", ọ dabeere na mmiri dị adị.
translations.reference: A curry can be either "dry" or "wet" depending on the amount of liquid.
translations.hypothesis: The weather can be "hot" or "humid," depending on the amount of moisture in the air.

translations.source: Ụmụ mpaghara imeala nke Ebe Ugwu Indịa na Pakistan, a na-ejikarị yogọọt n'ime ụmụ kọrị; n'ime Ebe Ndịda Indịa na mpaghara ndị ọzọ dị n'akụkụ mmiri nke okpuru kọntinent ahụ, a na-ejikarị mmiri ara akị oyibo.
translations.reference: In inland regions of Northern India and Pakistan, yogurt is commonly used in curries; in Southern India and some other coastal regions of the subcontinent, coconut milk is commonly used.
translations.hypothesis: In the northern regions of India and Pakistan, yogurt is commonly used in marinades for meat. In southern India and other coastal regions of the subcontinent, buttermilk is often used instead.

translations.source: Ebe enwere agwaetiti 17,000 isi wee họrọ, nri Indonesia bụ aha gburugburu nke a na-akpọ ọtụtụ erimeri nke ọtụtụ mpaghara dị na mba ahụ niile.
translations.reference: With 17,000 islands to choose from, Indonesian food is an umbrella term covering a vast variety of regional cuisines found across the nation.
translations.hypothesis: With over 17,000 islands to choose from, Indonesian cuisine is a diverse and flavorful collection of dishes that reflect the culinary traditions of various regions throughout the country.

translations.source: Mana, e kwuo ya n'etinyeghi nkọwa ọbụla, ihe a na-achọkarị ikwu bụ nri ahụ si n'etiti na ọwụwa anyanwu nke nnukwu agwaetiti Java.
translations.reference: But, if used without further qualifiers, the term tends to mean the food originally from the central and eastern parts of the main island Java.
translations.hypothesis: However, to put it simply, this dish is said to originate from the central and eastern parts of the large island of Java.

translations.source: Ugbu a ọ dị adị nke ukwuu na gburugburu òtù ụmụ agwaetiti ndị ahụ, nri Ndị Java nwere njirimara nri ndị etijuru ngwa nri na mfe n’usoro, ekpomeekpo ahụ kara dị ike Ndị Java kara nwee mmasị na ya ndị nke bụ ahụekere achịcha kpuchiri, ose, shuga (tụmadị shuga akị Ndị Java) na ngwa nrị ndị ọzọ nwere usi ọma.
translations.reference: Now widely available throughout the archipelago, Javanese cuisine features an array of simply seasoned dishes, the predominant flavorings the Javanese favor being peanuts, chillies, sugar (especially Javanese coconut sugar) and various aromatic spices.
translations.hypothesis: Currently, there is a growing trend among island communities where Javanese cuisine is gaining popularity. This cuisine is characterized by its use of readily available ingredients and simple cooking methods. Furthermore, Javanese cuisine is known for its emphasis on fresh ingredients, including vegetables, fruits, and spices (particularly Javanese sugar, also known as "gula Jawa"), as well as the use of healthy cooking techniques.

translations.source: Ihe nkonye ụkwụ bụ ihe na-ejide ụkwụ onye na-agba ịnyịnya nke na-awụdata n'akụkụ abụọ site oche elu ịnyịnya.
translations.reference: Stirrups are supports for the rider's feet that hang down on either side of the saddle.
translations.hypothesis: The pedal is the component that connects the cyclist's foot to the crankset, allowing them to transfer power to the drivetrain. It is typically located on either side of the crankset.

translations.source: Ha na-ewetara onye na-agba ha nnukwu nnọsi ike mana ha nwere ike inwe nsogbu nchekwa maka na ụkwụ onye na-agba ya pụrụ ịkpachi n'ime ha.
translations.reference: They provide greater stability for the rider but can have safety concerns due to the potential for a rider's feet to get stuck in them.
translations.hypothesis: They are facing a significant challenge, but they may also have security concerns because the attacker's feet could potentially slip and fall into the area.

translations.source: Ọ bụrụ na esị n'elu ịnyịnya tụpụ onye na-anya ya mana ụkwụ onye ahụ ekonye n'ekike ịnyịnya, ịnyịnya nwere ike ịsekpụrụ ya na-aga ma ọ gbaa ọsọ. Iji belata ihe egwu a, enwere ụfọdụ ihe mkpachapụ anya enwere ike ime.
translations.reference: If a rider is thrown from a horse but has a foot caught in the stirrup, they could be dragged if the horse runs away. To minimize this risk, a number of safety precautions can be taken.
translations.hypothesis: If a person slips and falls while wearing roller skates, but their feet remain within the skates, the skates can propel them forward and they may fall at a higher speed. To reduce this risk, there are some precautions that can be taken.

translations.source: Na mbụ, ọtụtụ n’ime ndị na-anya na-eyi akpụkpọ ụkwụ ọnyịnya ndị nwere kọị kọị na okpuru dị nrọ ma pee mpe.
translations.reference: First, most riders wear riding boots with a heel and a smooth, quite narrow, sole.
translations.hypothesis: Initially, many of the fashionable people were wearing comfortable, soft leather shoes with low heels.

translations.source: Ọzọ, ụfọdụ sadụl, ọkachasị sadụl Bekee, nwere ebe nchekwa na-ekwe ka akpụkpọ anụ si na sadụl dapụ ma onye na-anya anya sere ya laa azụ mgbe ọ na-ada.
translations.reference: Next, some saddles, particularly English saddles, have safety bars that allow a stirrup leather to fall off the saddle if pulled backwards by a falling rider.
translations.hypothesis: Furthermore, some shoes, particularly those made in England, have a reinforced area that prevents the leather from stretching and allows the wearer to adjust the fit as the shoe molds to their foot over time.

translations.source: Ndagwurugwuru Cochamó - ebe arimelu nwere ogo kachasị elu nke Chile, a mara dị ka Yosemite nke Ndịda Amerịka, ya na ụdị dị iche iche nke ụmụ nnukwu ahụaja kọnkịrị na nnukwu nkume.
translations.reference: Cochamó Valley - Chile's premier climbing destination, known as the Yosemite of South America, with a variety of granite big walls and crags.
translations.hypothesis: The Cochamó region – a place of exceptional beauty and the highest point in Chile, often referred to as the "Yosemite of South America" – is characterized by its diverse array of granite peaks and towering rock formations.

translations.source: Ụmụ ọnụ ugwu kachasị elu gụnyere nlenle ndị magburu onwe ha site n'elu ebe ndị ahụ. Ndị na-arị elu si n'akụkụ ụwa niile na-awapụta mgbe niile ụzọ ọhụrụ site n'ahụaja ya niile e nwere ike isi wapụta ụzọ nke anaghị agwụ agwụ.
translations.reference: Summits include breath-taking views from peaks. Climbers from all parts of the world are continually establishing new routes amongst its endless potential of walls.
translations.hypothesis: The highest mountain peaks include measurements taken from above the surrounding terrain. People from all over the world constantly discover new routes through these mountains, and it is possible to find paths that are both challenging and rewarding.

translations.source: Kpoda-ugwu egwuregwu-snow, bu nke gunyere igba igwe mmiri ski na snowboard, bu egwuregwu amaara-amaara nke gbasara ikpoda ala site n’elu n’ogige juputara na snow jiri igwe ski na snowboard eyigidere n’ukwu gi.
translations.reference: Downhill snowsports, which include skiing and snowboarding, are popular sports involving sliding down snow-covered terrain with skis or a snowboard attached to your feet.
translations.hypothesis: Snow sports, which include skiing and snowboarding, are popular activities that involve descending a snow-covered slope using skis or a snowboard, which are attached to your feet.

translations.source: Egwuregwu skii bụ otu isi ihe omume n'etiti ndị ọ na-amasị, mgbe ụfọdụ a na-amara ya dị ka "ski bums," na-eme atụmatụ nke oge ezumike niile gburugburu ime skii n'otu ebe kpọmkwem.
translations.reference: Skiing is a major travelling activity with many enthusiasts, occasionally known as "ski bums," planning entire vacations around skiing at a particular location.
translations.hypothesis: Skiing is a popular activity among enthusiasts, sometimes referred to as "ski bums," who often plan their entire vacation around skiing at a specific location.

translations.source: Egwuregwu ski eteela ọ nọ — ụmụ eserese esere n'ọgba kemgbe 5000 BC na-egosi ndị egwuregwu ski!
translations.reference: The idea of skiing is very old — cave paintings depicting skiers date back as far as 5000 BC!
translations.hypothesis: Skiing has a long history – cave paintings from 5000 BC depict people who appear to be skiing!

translations.source: Igwu skii na mgbada ugwu dị ka otu egwuregwu gara azụ ruo opekata mpe ọ bụrụ na arị afọ iri na asaa, ma n’ime 1861 òtù egwuregwu skii ntụrụndụ nke mbụ bụ nke emepere site n’aka Ndị Nọọwei n’ime Ọstrelịa.
translations.reference: Downhill skiing as a sport goes back to at least the 17th century, and in 1861 the first recreational ski club was opened by Norwegians in Australia.
translations.hypothesis: Skiing in mountainous areas has been a recreational activity for at least seventy years, but the first organized ski resort was established by Norwegians in Australia in 1861.

translations.source: Njem mfe ski: A na-akpọkwa omume a bakkọntrị ski, ije nlegharị anya ski maọbụ ịrị ugwu ski.
translations.reference: Backpacking by ski: This activity is also called backcountry ski, ski touring or ski hiking.
translations.hypothesis: Here's a simple ski trip: This activity is also known as skiing, snow sports, or downhill skiing.

translations.source: O metụtara mana ọ naghị agụnyekarị ọdịdị njem nleta ski keugwu ma ọ bụ egwuregwu ịrị elu ugwu, nke ikpeazụ ndị a e mere n'ọdịdịala kpodara ekpoda ma na-achọ ụmụ ski na buutu kara sie ike.
translations.reference: It is related to but usually not involving alpine style ski touring or mountaineering, the latter ones done in steep terrain and requiring much stiffer skis and boots.
translations.hypothesis: While it's suitable for general use, it doesn't typically cater to the specific needs of ski trips or mountain climbing activities. The latter, in particular, require more robust and durable equipment.

translations.source: Chee echiche maka ụzọ esi egwu egwuregwu skii dị ka ụzọ e si aga njem ije nke yiri.
translations.reference: Think of the skiing route as of a similar hiking route.
translations.hypothesis: Think of skiing as a form of hiking, but instead of walking, you're gliding on skis.

translations.source: N'ọnọdụ dị mma i nwere ike ịgarute ntoanya buru ibu karịa ịga ije - mana ọ na-ara ahụ tupu i rute ekwomọsọ nke ime skii ofe mba n'enweghị otu akpa azụ dị arụ n'ime mkpọwaraụzọ akwadogwere.
translations.reference: In good conditions you will be able to cover somewhat greater distances than walking – but only very seldom you will get the speeds of cross country skiing without a heavy backpack in groomed tracks.
translations.hypothesis: Under ideal conditions, you can achieve significantly greater distances than walking – but it's a risky endeavor to attempt to ski across a country without proper equipment, especially without a suitable backpack.

translations.source: Yurop bụ kọntinent dị obere na mmetụta ma nwee ọtụtụ mba nwere onwe ha. N’okpuru ọnọdụ nkịtị, ime njem gafee ọtụtụ mba ga-apụta ị ga site na ntinye akwụkwọ maka visa na njikwa paspọọtụ ọtụtụ oge.
translations.reference: Europe is a continent that is relatively small but with many independent countries. Under normal circumstances, travelling through multiple countries would mean having to go through visa applications and passport control multiple times.
translations.hypothesis: Europe is a relatively small continent with many independent countries. Under normal circumstances, traveling through several countries would likely involve multiple visa applications and passport checks.

translations.source: Agbanyeghị, mpaghara Schengen na-arụ ọrụ dịka mba a na-akwanyere ugwu.
translations.reference: The Schengen zone, however, works somewhat like one country in this respect.
translations.hypothesis: However, the Schengen Area functions as a single country.

translations.source: Ọ bụrụ na ị nọrọ n'ọgbọ a, i nwere ike igafe oke ala ma zere nnyocha paspọtụ.
translations.reference: As long as you stay in this zone, you can generally cross borders without going through passport control checkpoints again.
translations.hypothesis: If you are in this generation, you might be able to cross borders and avoid passport checks.

translations.source: N'otu aka ahụ, site n’inwe otu visa Schengen, ị kwesịghịzi itinye akwụkwọ maka visa otu n’ime mba ndịòtù Schengen nke ọ bụla iche, ya mere chekwa oge, ego na mmepe akwụkwọ.
translations.reference: Similarly, by having a Schengen visa, you do not need to apply for visas to each of the Schengen member countries separately, hence saving time, money and paperwork.
translations.hypothesis: Similarly, with a single Schengen visa, you don't need to apply for a separate visa for each individual Schengen member country, which saves you time, money, and paperwork.

translations.source: Onweghi nkwekọrịta zuru ụwa maka ngwa a na-akpọ ihe ochie. Ụfọdụ ụlọ ọrụ ụtụ na-akpọ ngwa ndị karịrị afọ 100 ihe ochie.
translations.reference: There is no universal definition for which manufactured items are antiques. Some tax agencies define goods older than 100 years as antiques.
translations.hypothesis: There is no universally agreed-upon definition for what constitutes an "antique." Some tax authorities consider items over 100 years old to be antiques.

translations.source: Nkọwasị ahụ nwere ọdịiche kwa ọdịdị ala, ebe ókè afọ nwere ike ịdị obere karịa n'ebe ndị dị ka Ugwu Amerịka karịa n'ime Yurop.
translations.reference: The definition has geographic variations, where the age limit might be shorter in places such as North America than in Europe.
translations.hypothesis: The life expectancy varies depending on the region, with people in areas like North America generally having a lower life expectancy than those in Europe.

translations.source: Enwere ike ikpo ngwaahia eji aka ruo ihe mgbe ochie, n’agbanyeghi na o di ohuru karia ngwaahia ndi nke emere maka oha.
translations.reference: Handicraft products might be defined as antiques, though they are younger than similar mass-produced goods.
translations.hypothesis: While hand tools have been around for a long time, they are relatively newer than tools that were mass-produced for the general public.

translations.source: Ọzụzụ Reindeer dị mkpa nke ukwuu ọkachasị n’ime ihe banyere ndụ na omenaala ndị Sámi nakwa ahịa gbara ya okirikiri dịkwa mkpa maka ọtụtụ akaọrụ ndị ọzọ.
translations.reference: Reindeer husbandry is an important livelihood among the Sámi and the culture surrounding the trade is important also for many with other professions.
translations.hypothesis: The reindeer population is of great importance, particularly in relation to the lives and culture of the Sámi people, and it also plays a vital role in many other industries.

translations.source: Ọbụna n'ọdịnala, agbanyeghị, ọ bụghị Sámi niile bụ ndị metụtara n'ime nnukwu ogo ọzụzụ anụmanụ reendiya, mana biri site n'igbu azụ, ịchụ nta na ihe yiri ya, na-enwe reendiya n'ọtụtụ oge dị ka ụmụ anụmanụ akpọbatara.
translations.reference: Even traditionally, though, not all Sámi have been involved in big scale reindeer husbandry, but lived from fishing, hunting and similar, having reindeer mostly as draft animals.
translations.hypothesis: Even traditionally, not all Sami people were involved in large-scale reindeer herding, but rather lived by fishing, hunting, and similar activities, raising reindeer only occasionally as livestock.

translations.source: Taa ọtụtụ Sámi na-arụ ọrụ n’ụmụ ahịa nke ugbu a. Njem nleta bụ mkpata egọ dị mkpa na Sápmi, mpaghara Sámi ahụ.
translations.reference: Today many Sámi work in modern trades. Tourism is an important income in Sápmi, the Sámi area.
translations.hypothesis: Today, many Sami people work in the tourism industry. Sightseeing is a significant part of the economy in Sápmi, the Sami region.

translations.source: Agbanyeghị na ndị abụghị ndị Roma na-ekwu ya n'etiti ha, a na-ahụta aha a bụ "Gypsy" dị ka aha ọjọọ maka na ọ gbasara ụfọdụ ụzọ ọjọọ ndị ọzọ si ahụta ndị Roma, nke abụghị eziokwu.
translations.reference: Though it is widely used, especially among non-Romani, the word "Gypsy" is often considered offensive because of its associations with negative stereotypes and inaccurate perceptions of Romani people.
translations.hypothesis: Despite what non-Roma people may say among themselves, the term "Gypsy" is often considered a derogatory name because it is associated with certain negative stereotypes that others have historically held about Roma people, which are not based on reality.

translations.source: Ọ bụrụ na mba ahụ ị ga-aga ileta bụrụ nke nọ n'okpuru otu ndụmọdụ njem, mkpuchi ahụike njem gị ma ọ bụ mkpuchi nkagbu njem gị bụ nke o nwere ike imetụta.
translations.reference: If the country you will be visiting becomes subject to a travel advisory, your travel health insurance or your trip cancellation insurance may be affected.
translations.hypothesis: If the country you are traveling to is subject to specific travel advisories, your travel insurance or travel accident insurance policy may be affected.

translations.source: Ị nwere ike ịjụta ndụmọdụ nke ndị ọchịchị karịa nke gị, mana ndụmọdụ ha bụ ndị e mebere maka ndị amaala ha.
translations.reference: You may also wish to consult the advice of governments other than your own, but their advice is designed for their citizens.
translations.hypothesis: You can seek advice from leaders, but their advice is often tailored to their own constituents.

translations.source: Iji mee atụ, ndị Amerịka nọ na Mịdụl Ist nwere ike igabiga ihe dị iche n'ihe ndị Yurop maọbụ Arab ga-agabiga.
translations.reference: As one example, American citizens in the Middle East might face different situations from Europeans or Arabs.
translations.hypothesis: For example, Americans in the Middle East might experience cultural differences compared to what Europeans or Arabs would encounter.

translations.source: Ndị ndụmọdụ gasị bụ naanị obere nchịkọta nke ọnọdụ ndọrọndọrọ ọchịchị n’otu obodo.
translations.reference: Advisories are merely a brief summary of the political situation in one country.
translations.hypothesis: Expert opinions are simply a small sample of the political climate within a community.

translations.source: Uche ndị e gosipụtara na-esekarị n'elu, n'izugbe na ntọghasị dị ukwuu ma a tụnyere ya ozi ndị a kọwara nke ọma dị ebe ọzọ.
translations.reference: The views presented are often cursory, general and oversimplified compared to the more detailed information available elsewhere.
translations.hypothesis: The opinions expressed are often superficial, broad, and lack depth compared to the more detailed information provided elsewhere.

translations.source: Ajọ ihu igwe bụ aha izugbe a na-akpọ ihe ọbụla gbasara ihu igwe nke nwere ike imebi ihe, ghasaa mmekọrịta, maọbụ gbuo mmadụ.
translations.reference: Severe weather is the generic term for any dangerous weather phenomenon with the potential to cause damage, serious social disruption, or loss of human life.
translations.hypothesis: A weather phenomenon is a general term for any atmospheric event that can cause damage, disruption, or loss of life.

translations.source: Ihu igwe dị oke njọ nwere ike ime n'ebe ọbụla n'ụwa, ma o nwere ụdị dị iche iche, nke nwere ike idabere na ọdịdịala, ọdịdịebe na ọnọdụ keikuku.
translations.reference: Severe weather can occur anywhere in the world, and there are different types of it, which can depend on geography, topography, and atmospheric conditions.
translations.hypothesis: Severe weather can occur anywhere in the world, and it can take many different forms, depending on the geographical location, season, and atmospheric conditions.

translations.source: Ụmụ oke ifufe, mkpụrụ mmiri, oke mmiri ozuzo, na ọkụọhịa bụ ụmụ ụdị na mmetụta nke ihu igwe dị oke njọ, dị ka ụmụ egbe eluigwe mmiri ozuzo, ajọọ̀ oke ifufe, ajọọ̀ ifufe mmiri, na ajọọ̀ oke mmiri ozuzo.
translations.reference: High winds, hail, excessive precipitation, and wildfires are forms and effects of severe weather, as are thunderstorms, tornadoes, waterspouts, and cyclones.
translations.hypothesis: Thunderstorms, rain showers, heavy rainfall, and thunderstorms are types and effects of severe weather, such as thunderstorms, heavy rainstorms, rain showers, and heavy downpours.

translations.source: Ihe ihu igwe siri ike na-eme na mpaghara na n'oge ụfọdụ gụnyere blizadị, oke ikuku na ọdịda ibubeoyi, oke ikuku na ọdịda aịzị, na oke ifufe na-ebu aja.
translations.reference: Regional and seasonal severe weather phenomena include blizzards, snowstorms, ice storms, and dust storms.
translations.hypothesis: Severe weather events can occur in various regions and may include blizzards, extreme heat waves, droughts, floods, and heavy thunderstorms.

translations.source: Ana adusi ndi njem odu ike ha mara gbasara ihe ndaba nke ekpem-oku maobu di oke ukwuu nke na emetuta ogbe ha dika onwere ike imetuta atumatu ime-njem obula.
translations.reference: Travellers are strongly advised to be aware of any risk of severe weather affecting their area as they may affect any travel plans.
translations.hypothesis: People are increasingly aware of the environmental impact of air travel and are looking for ways to reduce their carbon footprint, such as choosing more fuel-efficient airlines or offsetting their emissions.

translations.source: Onye ọbụla na-achọ ịga mba ọbụla bụ ọgbọ agha kwesịrị ka e kuziere ya etu e si eme ya.
translations.reference: Anyone planning a visit to a country that could be considered a war zone should get professional training.
translations.hypothesis: Every citizen who desires to travel to another country should be educated on how to do so properly.

translations.source: Ọchịchọ n'ịntanetị maka 'Ọmụmụ gburugburu keiro' nwere ike iweta adreesị otu ụlọọrụ imeobodo.
translations.reference: A search of the Internet for 'Hostile environment course' will probably provide the address of a local company.
translations.hypothesis: An online search for "environmental science degree" may yield the address of a local institution.

translations.source: Otu ihe ọmụmụ ga-akọwa nke ọma ihe niile a kọwara ebe a tinyekwa ahụmihe bara uru.
translations.reference: A course will normally cover all the issues discussed here in far greater detail, usually with practical experience.
translations.hypothesis: A comprehensive explanation of everything described here will be provided, along with valuable insights.

translations.source: Ihe ọmụmụ na-abụkarị site na ụbọchị abuo ruo ụbọchị ise ma ọ ga-emetụta mmepụta omume, ọtụtụ mgbata ọsọ enyemaka mbụ na ọzụzụ maka ngwaagha n'oge ụfọdụ .
translations.reference: A course will normally be from 2-5 days and will involve role play, a lot of first aid and sometimes weapons training.
translations.hypothesis: Training typically lasts from two to five days and can affect productivity, initial response times, and even combat readiness in some cases.

translations.source: Ụmụ akwụkwọ na magaziini ndị na-akọ maka nlanarị nke ọzara juru eju, mana ụmụ mbipụta na-akọ maka ebe a na-alụ agha dị obere.
translations.reference: Books and magazines dealing with wilderness survival are common, but publications dealing with war zones are few.
translations.hypothesis: While journalists and magazines often report on major international conflicts, news outlets tend to focus less on smaller, localized conflicts.

translations.source: Ndị njem ụgbọ mmiri na-eme atụmatụ ịwa ahụ ntụgharị mmekọahụ na mba ofesi ga-ejiriri n'aka na ha ji ụmụ akwụkwọ ziri ezi maka njem nlaghachi.
translations.reference: Voyagers planning sex reassignment surgery abroad must ensure they're carrying valid documents for the return trip.
translations.hypothesis: Travel agencies that arrange gender reassignment surgeries abroad should ensure that their clients have proper documentation for their return journey.

translations.source: Ịdị njikere ndị ọchịchị inye akwụkwọ ikike ngafe ndị a na-edepụtaghị jenda ha (X) maọbụ dọkụmentị emelitere ka ọ daba n’aha a chọrọ ma jenda adị iche.
translations.reference: The willingness of governments to issue passports with gender not stated (X) or documents updated to match a desired name and gender varies.
translations.hypothesis: Be prepared to provide the authorities with the necessary identification documents, whether they are original documents (X) or updated documents, to verify your identity and ensure they match the information you provide.

translations.source: Njikere nke ndị ọchịchị mba ndị ọzọ ịsọpụrụ akwụkwọ ndị a dị nnọọ ka ihe na-agbanwe agbanwe.
translations.reference: Willingness of foreign governments to honour these documents is just as widely variable.
translations.hypothesis: The willingness of foreign governments to respect these documents is constantly changing.

translations.source: Ọchịchọ na ebe nyocha nchedo abụrụkwala oke nsogbu mbanye n’ike n’ime oge Septemba 11, 2001 gachara.
translations.reference: Searches at security checkpoints have also become far more intrusive in the post-September 11, 2001 era.
translations.hypothesis: Security checks and screenings have become a major concern in the aftermath of the September 11, 2001 attacks.

translations.source: Ndi transgender n’emebeghi oparashon atubekwana anya na ha gafecha ihe nyocha na ha ka ga ano na nzuzo ma ugwu ha adikwachim.
translations.reference: Pre-operative transgender people should not expect to pass through the scanners with their privacy and dignity intact.
translations.hypothesis: Transgender individuals are increasingly undergoing cosmetic surgeries, but they still face challenges, including the need for further medical evaluations and the stigma associated with their gender identity.

translations.source: Oke ọchịchị mmiri bụ mmiri na-asọlata asọlata site n'ebili mmiri tikapụrụ n'ọnụ, na-emekarị n'okwute ala mmiri maọbụ ihe yiri ya.
translations.reference: Rip currents are the returning flow from waves breaking off the beach, often at a reef or similar.
translations.hypothesis: A water reservoir is a body of water that collects and stores water from a source, typically located underground or in a similar structure.

translations.source: N'ihi tọpọlọjì nke okpuru mmiri ahụ, mmiri na-abanyeghachi dị ike n'akụkụ ole na ole miri emi, ma ike ọwụwụ mmiri ngwa ngwa ruo na mmiri dị omimi nwere ike ịmepụta n'ebe ahụ.
translations.reference: Due to the underwater topology the return flow is concentrated at a few deeper sections, and a fast current to deep water may form there.
translations.hypothesis: Due to the topography of the riverbed, the water flow is strong in some areas, and sudden, powerful currents can develop in those locations, potentially reaching significant depths.

translations.source: Imirikiti ọnwụ na-eme n'ihi ike ọgwụgwụ n'ịgbalị igwughachi azụ megide kọrenti mmiri, nke nwere ike ọ gaghị ekwe omume.
translations.reference: Most deaths happen as result of fatigue trying to swim back against the current, which may be impossible.
translations.hypothesis: Most deaths occur due to the severity of the complications that arise when trying to reverse a current, which may be impossible.

translations.source: Ozugbo ị na-esi n'ọwụwụ mmiri ahụ pụta, igwughachi azụ na-aka ara ahụ karịa na nkịtị.
translations.reference: As soon as you get out of the current, swimming back is no more difficult than normally.
translations.hypothesis: As soon as you step out of the rain, your back feels much colder than usual.

translations.source: Gbalịa tụọ atụmatụ ọzọ maka ebe ejidebeghi gị, maọbụ, dabere na nka gị yana ma achọpụtala gị, ị nwere ike ịchere maka nnapụta.
translations.reference: Try aiming somewhere where you are not caught again or, depending on your skills and on whether you have been noticed, you might want to wait for rescue.
translations.hypothesis: Try to anticipate any potential consequences for your actions, or, depending on the circumstances and whether you have been apprehended, you may be eligible for bail.

translations.source: Mmenyeụjọ mbanyegharị abia na nkpirikpi karia mmenyeụjọ omenala (enwere agba họnịịmuunu dịtụ ntakịrị), dịruru ogologo, ma nwee ike ịka njọ.
translations.reference: Re-entry shock comes on sooner than culture shock (there's less of a honeymoon phase), lasts longer, and can be more severe.
translations.hypothesis: The rash appeared suddenly and was more intense than a typical rash (it was a deep red), it covered a large area, and it was quite painful.

translations.source: Ndị njem ndị nwere oge dị mfe ịnọgharị n’omenala ọhụrụ mgbe ụfọdụ na-enwe oge siri ike ịnọgharịkwa n’omenala keobodo ha.
translations.reference: Travellers who had an easy time adjusting to the new culture sometimes have a particularly hard time readjusting to their native culture.
translations.hypothesis: Sometimes, travelers who have a flexible schedule can easily adapt to new cultures, while others with more rigid schedules may find it more challenging to adjust to local customs.

translations.source: Mgbe a na-alaghachite n’ụlọ mgbe e bichara n’obodo oyibo, ị nweela mmara ahụ nye omenala ọhụrụ ahụ ma tufuokwa ụfọdụ agwa gị si n’omenala nke ụlọ gị.
translations.reference: When returning home after living abroad, you've adapted to the new culture and lost some of your habits from your home culture.
translations.hypothesis: After returning home from studying abroad in a Western country, you have gained new perspectives and experiences, but you may also find that some aspects of your personality have been influenced by your upbringing and cultural background.

translations.source: Mgbe ị gara na mba ofesi na mbụ, ndị mmadụ nwere ike ha nwere ndidi na nghọta, na-amara na ndị njem nọ n'ime mba ọhụrụ chọrọ imegharị ahụ nnọshị̀.
translations.reference: When you went abroad at first, people were probably patient and understanding, knowing that travellers in a new country need to adapt.
translations.hypothesis: When you travel to a foreign country for the first time, people are often patient and understanding, recognizing that visitors in a new environment need time to adjust.

translations.source: Ikekwe ndị mmadụ agaghị atụ anya na ndidi na nnagide bụ ihe ndị njem na-alaghachi ụlọ aghaghị inwe.
translations.reference: People may not anticipate that patience and understanding are also necessary for travellers returning home.
translations.hypothesis: People often underestimate the resilience and patience that are essential qualities for those returning home after a long journey.

translations.source: Ihe ngosi uda na oku piramidi bu ihe kachasi akpalite mmuo emere maka umuaka n’ebe a.
translations.reference: The pyramid sound and light show is one of the most interesting things in the area for kids.
translations.hypothesis: The ice cream and pyramid-shaped light show is the most impressive display of technology designed for children here.

translations.source: Ị nwere ike ịhụ piramidi n'ime itiri ma ị nwere ike ịhụ ha n'ịgbachi nkịtị tupu ihe ngosi ahụ ebido.
translations.reference: You can see the pyramids in the dark and you can see them in silence before the show begins.
translations.hypothesis: You can see the pyramids within the structure, and you can also see them in the quiet moments before the show begins.

translations.source: Mgbe niile ị na-anụkarị ụda ndị njem nleta na ndị na-ere ahịa. Akụkọ gbasara ụda na ọkụ dị nnọọ ka otu akwụkwọ akụkọ ifo.
translations.reference: Usually you always here the sound of tourists and vendors. The story of the sound and light is just like a story book.
translations.hypothesis: You often hear the sounds of tourists and vendors. Stories about sounds and lights are like a novel.

translations.source: Edobere Sphinx ka ihe mgbakwasa na onye na ako akuko toro ogologo
translations.reference: The Sphinx is set as the backdrop and the narrator of a long story.
translations.hypothesis: Edobere Sphinx is a fascinating and legendary storyteller.

translations.source: A na-egosipụta ihe ngosi ndị ahụ na piramidi ndị ahụ ma mere ka piramidi ndị ahụ dị iche iche na-enwukepụ.
translations.reference: The scenes are displayed on the pyramids and the different pyramids are lit up.
translations.hypothesis: The exhibits were displayed in the pyramids, and this caused the pyramids to become increasingly popular.

translations.source: Sawụt Shetland Aịlands, nke a chọpụtara na 1819, bụ ebe ọtụtụ mba na-azọ; Agwaetiti nọ na ya karịrị ndị nọ ebe ọzọ, ebe agụtara iri na isii nọ n'ọrụ n'afọ 2020.
translations.reference: South Shetland Islands, discovered in 1819, are claimed by several nations and have the most bases, with sixteen active in 2020.
translations.hypothesis: The Shetland Islands, discovered in 1819, are a region with significant international competition. The islands have a higher concentration of wind turbines than other areas, with sixty-six operating in 2020.

translations.source: Archipelago ahụ tọgbọọrọ na Km 120 na mpaghara ugwu nke obodo akụkụ mmiri ahụ. Nke kachasị buo ibu bụ Agwaetiti Eze George nwere ebe obibi nke Villa Las Estrellas.
translations.reference: The archipelago lies 120 km north of the Peninsula. The largest is King George Island with the settlement of Villa Las Estrellas.
translations.hypothesis: The archipelago is located 120 kilometers north of the mainland city. The largest island is King George Island, which is home to the Villa Las Estrellas settlement.

translations.source: Ndị ọzọ gụnyere Agwaetiti Livingston, na Nghọgbu ebe caldera mmiri tojuru nke ugwu mgbawa ka dị ire na-enye otu ebe obibi dị ịtụnanya.
translations.reference: Others include Livingston Island, and Deception where the flooded caldera of a still-active volcano provides a spectacular natural harbour.
translations.hypothesis: Other attractions include Livingston Island, with its stunning caldera lake and rugged mountain scenery, offering a unique natural environment.

translations.source: Ala Ellsworth bụ mpaghara ndịna nke Penịnsụla, Oke osimiri Bellingshausen gbara ya gburugburu.
translations.reference: Ellsworth Land is the region south of the Peninsula, bounded by the Bellingshausen Sea.
translations.hypothesis: The Ellsworth region is a subantarctic area located on the Antarctic Peninsula, surrounded by the Bellingshausen Sea.

translations.source: Ugwu ndị Peninsụla ahụ nọ ebe a jikọtara ọnụ ịghọ ugwu dị larịị ahụ, mgbe ahụ jikọgharịa ịghọ km 360 eriri igwe nke Ugwu ndị Ellsworth ahụ, egbubiri abụọ site n’aka Glesịa Minnesota ahụ.
translations.reference: The mountains of the Peninsula here merge into the plateau, then re-emerge to form the 360 km chain of the Ellsworth Mountains, bisected by the Minnesota Glacier.
translations.hypothesis: The mountains of the Peninsula region are a series of connected peaks that eventually form a 360-kilometer arc, encompassing the Ellsworth Mountains, which are located just across from the state of Minnesota.

translations.source: Akụkụ ebe ugwu ma ọ bụ Renji Sentinel nwere ugwu ndị kachasị elu nke Antaatika, Vinson Massif ahụ, na-eru ọnụ elu na 4892 m Ugwu Vinson.
translations.reference: The northern part or Sentinel Range has Antarctica's highest mountains, the Vinson Massif, peaking at 4892 m Mount Vinson.
translations.hypothesis: The Antarctic Peninsula, also known as the Renji Sentinel, is home to some of the highest mountains in Antarctica, including the Vinson Massif, which reaches a height of 4,892 meters at Mount Vinson.

translations.source: N'ebe ndị zopuru ezopu, n'enweghị netwọk ekwentị, ikekwe ekwentị satịlaịt ga-abụ naanị nzọpụta i nwere.
translations.reference: In remote locations, without cell phone coverage, a satellite phone may be your only option.
translations.hypothesis: In remote areas with no mobile network coverage, a satellite phone might be your only lifeline.

translations.source: Otu ekwentị satịlaịtị abụghị nnọchite anya n’izugbe nke ekwentị kengagharị, dị ka ị kwesịrị ịnọ n’ezi ya na inwe ụzọ warawara ịhụ satịlaịtị iji ya kpọọ oku ekwentị.
translations.reference: A satellite phone is not generally a replacement for a mobile phone, as you have to be outdoors with clear line of sight to the satellite to make a phone call.
translations.hypothesis: A satellite phone is not a substitute for a regular mobile phone, as it requires a clear line of sight to a satellite in order to make calls.

translations.source: Ọrụ ahụ bụ nke mbupu na-ejikarị, gụnyere nka obi ụtọ, ya na ụmụ njem nchọpụta ndị nwere mkpa datà ebe dịanya na olu.
translations.reference: The service is frequently used by shipping, including pleasure craft, as well as expeditions who have remote data and voice needs.
translations.hypothesis: The task involves data collection and analysis, often incorporating elements of fieldwork and engaging with individuals who possess valuable information and diverse perspectives.

translations.source: Onye ọrụ ekwentị ebeụlọ gị kwesịrị inwe ike inyekwu ozi gbasara ị na-ejikọta n'ọrụ a.
translations.reference: Your local telephone service provider should be able to give more information about connecting to this service.
translations.hypothesis: Your home phone service provider should be able to provide you with more information about this particular service.

translations.source: Otu nhọrọ kara ewu ewu n'ụzọ na-amụbanye maka ndị na-atụ arọ ịnara otu ohere-afọ bụ ime njem ma mụta.
translations.reference: An increasingly more popular option for those planning a gap-year is to travel and learn.
translations.hypothesis: One increasingly popular and effective strategy for students aiming to gain admission to highly competitive universities is to travel and learn.

translations.source: Ọ bụ ndị si ụlọ akwụkwọ pụta na-emekarị nke a, maka ọ na-ekwe ka ha jiri otu afọ zuo ike tupu ha abanye mahadum, ma ghara imebi mmụta ha.
translations.reference: This is especially popular with school leavers, allowing them to take a year out before university, without compromising their education.
translations.hypothesis: This is often done by students who are preparing to graduate from high school, as it allows them to gain valuable experience before entering university without disrupting their studies.

translations.source: Ọtụtụ oge, ịdebanye aha n'ọmụmụ ohere-afọ na mba ofesi nwere ike imelite n'ezie ohere i nwere isonye n'agụmakwụkwọ dị elu n'obodo ebe i si.
translations.reference: In many cases, enrolling on a gap-year course abroad can actually improve your chances of moving into higher education back in your home country.
translations.hypothesis: Often, obtaining a degree from a foreign university can significantly improve your chances of being accepted into prestigious educational programs in your home country.

translations.source: A ga-enwekarị ụgwọ akwụkwọ iji debanye aha n’ime ụmụ emume mmụta ndị a.
translations.reference: Typically there will be a tuition fee to enroll in these educational programs.
translations.hypothesis: There will likely be tuition fees to enroll in these educational programs.

translations.source: Finlandị bụ ebe dị oke mma maka inya ụgbọ mmiri. “Ala nke otu puku ọdọ mmiri” ahụ nwekwara ọtụtụ puku agwaetiti, n’ime ọdọ mmiri ndị ahụ ma n’akụkụ mmiri nke òtù agwaetiti.
translations.reference: Finland is a great boating destination. The "Land of a thousand lakes" has thousands of islands too, in the lakes and in the coastal archipelagos.
translations.hypothesis: Finland is an excellent destination for boating. This "land of a thousand lakes" also boasts tens of thousands of islands, both within the lakes and along the coastline.

translations.source: Na otu agwaetiti n’umu ọdọ mmiri ị gaghị achọriri ụgbọ mmiri.
translations.reference: In the archipelagos and lakes you do not necessarily need a yacht.
translations.hypothesis: On an island surrounded by water, you wouldn't need a boat.

translations.source: Agbanyeghị n'òtù agwaetiti akụkụ mmiri ahụ na ụmụ ọdọ mmiri kachasị ibu bụ ndị nke buru ibu n'ezie maka yaach ọ bụla, ụgbọ mmiri ndị kara obere ma ọ bụ ọbụna otu kayak na-enye ahụmihe dị iche.
translations.reference: Although the coastal archipelagos and the biggest lakes are indeed big enough for any yacht, smaller boats or even a kayak offer a different experience.
translations.hypothesis: While the coastal island is known for its large cruise ships, which are certainly impressive in their own right, smaller vessels like boats or even kayaks offer a different kind of experience.

translations.source: Akwọm ụgbọmmiri bụ ihe mmemme nchereoge na mba Finlandị, nke bụ otu ụgbọmmiri ibu mmadụ asaa maọbụ asatọ.
translations.reference: Boating is a national pastime in Finland, with a boat to every seven or eight people.
translations.hypothesis: A "sauna" is a traditional Finnish steam bath, typically accommodating seven or eight people.

translations.source: Norway, Sweden na New Zealand emegokwa ya, mana ewezụga ha, ihe a bụ ihe mmeta pụrụ iche (dịka ọmụmaatụ na Netherlands fịgọ a bụ otu nye iri anọ).
translations.reference: This is matched by Norway, Sweden and New Zealand, but otherwise quite unique (e.g. in the Netherlands the figure is one to forty).
translations.hypothesis: Norway, Sweden, and New Zealand have similar policies, but in addition to them, this is a unique initiative (for example, in the Netherlands, it's available to one in forty people).

translations.source: Ọtụtụ n'ime Njem Ụgbọmmiri Baltik pụrụiche na-enye njirimara nke ọnụnọ agbatịrị n'ime St. Pitasbọọg Rọshịa.
translations.reference: Most of the distinct Baltic Cruises feature an extended stay in St. Petersburg, Russia.
translations.hypothesis: Many of the Baltic cruise itineraries include a stop in St. Petersburg, Russia.

translations.source: Nke a pụtara na i nwere ike ịwere ụfọdụ ụbọchị gaa leta obodo ochie a, ma na-echighata n'ụgbọ mmiri ịrahụ ụra abalị.
translations.reference: This means you can visit the historic city for a couple of full days while returning and sleeping on the ship at night.
translations.hypothesis: This means you can spend a few days visiting this historic town, but you'll need to take a boat to spend the night.

translations.source: Ọ bụrụ na ị nọ n'ụgbọmmiri eme njem nlereanya nke naanị elu ala ị gaghị enweta visa dị iche maka ya (bidori na 2009).
translations.reference: If you only go ashore using shipboard excursions you will not need a separate visa (as of 2009).
translations.hypothesis: If you are traveling on a trial flight that only operates within the country, you will not need a separate visa for it (effective since 2009).

translations.source: Ụfọdụ njem ụgbọ mmiri na-enye njirimara Beelịn, Jamani n'ime ụmụ broshuọ ahụ. Dị ka ị nwere ike ịhụ site na maapụ ahụ n'elu Beelịn anọghị oke osimiri ahụ nso ma ọlị ma otu nleta n'obodo ahụ bụ nke agụnyeghị n'ọnụahịa nke njem ụgbọ mmiri ahụ.
translations.reference: Some cruises feature Berlin, Germany in the brochures. As you can see from the map above Berlin is no where near the sea and a visit to the city is not included in the price of the cruise.
translations.hypothesis: Some of the cruise itineraries include a stop in Belgium, Germany, within the brochure. As you can see from the map above, Belgium is not located very close to the sea, and one of the stops in the city is not included in the price of the cruise.

translations.source: Njem ụgbọ elu nwere ike bụ ihe egwu ny onye ọbụla agbanyeghị afọ ole ha dị maobụ ebe ha si, ọkachasị ma ọ bụrụ na ha efebeghị mbụ maọbụ na ha enwego ihe ọghọm mbụ.
translations.reference: Travelling by plane can be a scary experience for people of all ages and backgrounds, particularly if they've not flown before or have experienced a traumatic event.
translations.hypothesis: Flying on an airplane can be daunting for anyone, regardless of their age or background, especially if they are flying for the first time or have had a negative experience in the past.

translations.source: Ọ bụghị ihe ihere: ọ dịghị iche dị n'etiti ya na mmadụ inwe egwu gbasara ihe nwere ike ime na ndụ ya nakwa enweghi mmasị n'ihe ndị ọzọ nke ọtụtụ mmadụ nwere.
translations.reference: It is not something to be ashamed of: it is no different from the personal fears and dislikes of other things that very many people have.
translations.hypothesis: It's not shameful: there's no difference between being afraid of what might happen in your life and not being interested in the things that many other people are.

translations.source: Maka ụfọdụ, nghọta ihe gbasara otu ụgbọ elu si arụ ọrụ na ihe na-eme n'ime otu njem ụgbọelu nwere ike inye aka ịgabiga ụjọ nke dabere na ihe amaghị ma ọ bụ anọghị na njikwa.
translations.reference: For some, understanding something about how aircraft work and what happens during a flight may help to overcome a fear which is based on the unknown or on not being in control.
translations.hypothesis: For some, understanding how an airplane works and what happens during a flight can help alleviate anxiety stemming from the unknown or a lack of control.

translations.source: A na-akwụ ndị ụlọ ọrụ na-ebugharị ngwa ụgwọ nke ọma maka ibuga ihe ngwa ngwa. Kwa ugboro, oge dị ezigbo mkpa n'ebe akwụkwọ azụmahịa nọ, ngwa ahịa maọbụ akụkụ nnochite maka nrụzi igwe ọbụla ngwa ngwa.
translations.reference: Courier companies are well paid for delivering things quickly. Frequently, time is very important with business documents, merchandise or spare parts for an urgent repair.
translations.hypothesis: Companies are often charged fees for expedited shipping to ensure timely delivery. These fees are particularly common when dealing with critical business documents, valuable goods, or replacement parts needed for urgent equipment repairs.

translations.source: N’ụzọ ụfọdụ, ụlọ ọrụ ndị kara buo ibu nwere ụgbọ elu nke ha, mana maka ụzọ ndị ọzọ na obere ụlọ ọrụ ndị ọzọ enwere otu nsogbu.
translations.reference: On some routes, the larger companies have their own planes, but for other routes and smaller firms there was a problem.
translations.hypothesis: Sometimes, larger companies have their own aircraft, but for other routes and smaller businesses, there is a common problem.

translations.source: Ọ bụrụ na ha jị ụgbọelu ziga ihe, n'ụfọdụ ụzọ, ikekwe ọ gaara ewe ọtụtụ ụbọchị igafere mbupusi na ndị kọstom.
translations.reference: If they sent things by air freight, on some routes it may have taken days to get through unloading and customs.
translations.hypothesis: If they ship the item by air, it might take several days for the package to clear customs and reach its destination.

translations.source: Naanị ụzọ a ga-esi ewefe ya ọsịịsọ wụbụ iziga ya dị ka ibu e nyochagoro. Iwu ụlọọrụ ụgbọelu agaghị ekwe ha izipụ ibu na-enweghị otu onye njem, nke bụ ebe ị ga-esi bata n'ime.
translations.reference: The only way to get it through faster was to send it as checked luggage. Airline regulations will not allow them to send luggage without a passenger, which is where you come in.
translations.hypothesis: The only way to transport it safely is to ship it as a checked bag. Airline regulations do not allow for items to be carried in the cabin without a passenger present.

translations.source: Ụzọ kachasị doo anya nke ife n’ime klaasị mbụ ma ọ bụ azụmahịa bụ iwepụta nnukwu ego maka urūàmàrà (ma ọ bụ, nke ka mma, mee ka ụlọ ọrụ gị mere gị ya).
translations.reference: The obvious way of flying in first or business class is to fork out a thick wad of money for the privilege (or, better yet, get your company to do it for you).
translations.hypothesis: The most straightforward way to achieve profitability in a new business or class is to allocate a significant amount of resources (or, ideally, have your company allocate those resources for you) towards marketing.

translations.source: Mana nke a adịghị ọnụ ala: dịka ihe i ga-ebu n'uche, lewe anya ịkwụ ugboro anọ ihe a na-akwụ maka ekọnọmi nkịtị maka biznes, na ihe ruru ugboro iri na otu maka fest klas!
translations.reference: However, this does not come cheap: as rough rules of thumb, you can expect to pay up to four times the normal economy fare for business, and eleven times for first class!
translations.hypothesis: However, this is not a fixed price: please note that the cost for a standard photoshoot for a business is approximately four times the price, and up to eleven times the price for a festive class photoshoot!

translations.source: Ikwu n'ozuzu, ọ baghị uru ọbụna ị na-ele anya maka ụmụ mbelata maka ochie ndị azụmaahịa ma ọ bụ klaasị-mbụ n'ụmụ njem ụgbọelu ozugbo sitere na A ruo B.
translations.reference: Generally speaking, there is no point in even looking for discounts for business or first-class seats on direct flights from A to B.
translations.hypothesis: Overall, it's not even worth considering discounted fares for senior citizens or first-class tickets for direct flights from point A to point B.

translations.source: Ndị ụgbọ elu mara nke ọma na o nwere isi òtù ndị na-agba ụgbọ elu ndị nwere ike ịkwụ ezigbo ego maka urūàmàrà nke irute ebe ọzọ ọsịsọ nakwa n’ezigbo ọnọdụ, ma gbaa ụgwọ etu o kwesịrị.
translations.reference: Airlines know well that there is a certain core group of flyers who are willing to pay top dollar for the privilege of getting somewhere fast and in comfort, and charge accordingly.
translations.hypothesis: Airline companies are well aware that there is a segment of passengers who are willing to pay a premium for the convenience of reaching their destination quickly and reliably, and they are charging accordingly.

translations.source: Isiobodo nke Moldova bụ Chișinău. Asụsụ keobodo ahụ bụ Romanian, mana a na-ejikarị Rọshịan.
translations.reference: The capital of Moldova is Chişinău. The local language is Romanian, but Russian is widely used.
translations.hypothesis: The capital of Moldova is Chișinău. The official language is Romanian, but Russian is also widely spoken.

translations.source: Moldova mba nwere ọtụtụ-agbụrụ nke nke tagwere ahụhụ sitere na ndọkụrịta agbụrụ.
translations.reference: Moldova is a multi-ethnic republic that has suffered from ethnic conflict.
translations.hypothesis: Moldova is a multi-ethnic country that has experienced social tensions stemming from ethnic diversity.

translations.source: N'afọ 1994, ọgbaaghara a butere nkepụta Mba Transnistria kenkwupụta-onwe n'ime ebe ọwụwaanyanwụ Moldova, nke nwere ọchịchị na ego nke ya mana onweghi mba ọbụla so n'otu UN nabatara ya.
translations.reference: In 1994, this conflict led to the creation of the self-proclaimed Transnistria Republic in eastern Moldova, which has its own government and currency but is not recognised by any UN member country.
translations.hypothesis: In 1994, a conflict arose in the breakaway region of Transnistria, located within Moldova. This region declared its independence, establishing its own government and currency, but it remains unrecognized by any UN member state.

translations.source: E dozigharịala njikọ akụnaụba dị n'etiti nkewa Moldova abụọ a n’agbanyeghi ọdịda na mkpakọrịta nkwe nke ndọrọndọrọ ọchịchị.
translations.reference: Economic links have been re-established between these two parts of Moldova despite the failure in political negotiations.
translations.hypothesis: Despite the political differences and occasional tensions, the economic ties between these two Moldovan entities remain strong.

translations.source: Okpukpe kachasị n'ime Moldova bụ Ụka Kraịstị Keọdịnala.
translations.reference: The major religion in Moldova is Orthodox Christian.
translations.hypothesis: The most famous landmark in Moldova is the Traditional Christian Church.

translations.source: Izmir bụ obodo nke atọ kacha buo ibu na mba Tọkị nwere ọnụọgụgụ ndị mmadụ dị ihe dịka nde 3. 7, ọdụ ụgbọmmiri nke abụọ kacha buo ibu ma a gụpụ Istanbulu, na ọdụ ụgbọ njem dị ezigbo mma.
translations.reference: İzmir is the third largest city in Turkey with a population of around 3.7 million, the second biggest port after Istanbul, and a very good transport hub.
translations.hypothesis: Izmir is the third most populous city in Turkey, with a population of approximately 3.7 million. It is the second largest port city after Istanbul and boasts a beautiful coastline.

translations.source: Obodo ochie nke Smyrna na mbụ, ọ bụzi ugbu a otu ebe na-ewi ewi, mepere emepe, na azụmaahịa dịnọrụ, e wubere gburugburu otu nnukwu ọnụ mmiri ma ụmụ ugwu gbaakwa ya gburugburu.
translations.reference: Once the ancient city of Smyrna, it is now a modern, developed, and busy commercial center, set around a huge bay and surrounded by mountains.
translations.hypothesis: The ancient city of Smyrna, which is no longer a bustling, open, and commercial center, is now a quiet place surrounded by a large harbor and hills.

translations.source: Ụmụ buulivadị ahụ sara mbara, ụlọ ndị nwere karama n'ihu ha na ebe ụlọ ahịa na-ewi ewi bụ ndị e wubechara n'iji eluụlọ taịlị-uhie keọdịnala, ụlọ ahịa narị afọ iri na asatọ ahụ, na ụmụ ụlọ alakụba na ụlọ ụka, agbanyeghị n'obodo ahụ nwere nkwụrụ nke kara bụrụ Mediterranean Yurop karịa Tọki keọdịnala.
translations.reference: The broad boulevards, glass-fronted buildings and modern shopping centers are dotted with traditional red-tiled roofs, the 18th century market, and old mosques and churches, although the city has an atmosphere more of Mediterranean Europe than traditional Turkey.
translations.hypothesis: The buildings are diverse, ranging from houses with small gardens in front to bustling shops, and include a traditional tile-roofed house, a 19th-century building, and apartment buildings and townhouses. However, the city's architecture leans more towards a Mediterranean European style than a traditional Turkish one.

translations.source: Obodo Haldarsvik na-ekwe ka ahụta Eysturọị, agwaetiti dị ya nso, ma nwekwaa ụlọ ụka akụkụ asatọ pụrụ iche.
translations.reference: The village of Haldarsvík offer views of the nearby island Eysturoy and has an unusual octagonal church.
translations.hypothesis: The town of Haldarsvik, located near the island of Eysturoy, also boasts eight unique guesthouses.

translations.source: Na yaadị ụlọ ụka, e nwere ụmụ nduru akpụrụ n’ofe ụfọdụ ili na-adọrọ mmasị.
translations.reference: In the churchyard, there are interesting marble sculptures of doves over some tombs.
translations.hypothesis: In the hotel garden, there were some interesting sculptures placed among the flowers.

translations.source: Ọ meritere nkeji iri atọ iji gagharịa n’ime obodo ahụ na-akpali akpali.
translations.reference: It's worth half an hour to stroll about the intriguing village.
translations.hypothesis: He deserved thirty minutes to explore the bustling city.

translations.source: Na aka-ugwu ma gburu-gburu dikwa nso igaru di obodo ihunanya na itunanya Sintra bukwa nke emere amara-amara nye ndi mba-ozo ka akowaputara idi-ukwu ya n’uzo egbuke-egbuke site na-aka Onye-nwe Byro.
translations.reference: To the north and within easy reach is the romantic and fascinating town of Sintra and which was made famous to foreigners after a glowing account of its splendours recorded by Lord Byron.
translations.hypothesis: Located in the picturesque town of Sintra, a UNESCO World Heritage site renowned for its beauty and charm, the palace was meticulously designed and built to impress visitors from around the world, showcasing the grandeur and opulence of the Byro family.

translations.source: Bọọsụ 403 Scotturb na-eme njem mgbedum aga Sintra, na-akwụsị na Cabo da Roca.
translations.reference: Scotturb Bus 403 travels regularly to Sintra, stopping at Cabo da Roca.
translations.hypothesis: Bus number 403 from Scotturb travels to Sintra in the evening, making a stop at Cabo da Roca.

translations.source: Ọzọkwa n'ugwu leta nnukwu Ebe Nsọ nke Nwanyị Anyị nke Fatima (Ebenchụaja), otu ebe ama ama n'ụwa niile maka ụmụ ihe ngosipụta nke Marịa.
translations.reference: Also to the north visit the great Sanctuary of Our Lady of Fatima (Shrine), a place of worldwide famous Marian apparitions.
translations.hypothesis: Furthermore, on the mountain, there is the grand Shrine of Our Lady of Fatima (Ebenchụaja), a world-renowned site famous for its apparitions of the Virgin Mary.

translations.source: biko cheta na ebe ina aga izute bu n’ezie ogige eliri otutu ozu, dika kwa nwere ihe-oputara ana agaghi agutali onu nye okere onu-ogugu uwa putara-ihe
translations.reference: Please remember that you are essentially visiting a mass grave site, as well as a site that has an almost incalculable meaning to a significant portion of the world's population.
translations.hypothesis: Please remember that the place where we will be meeting is actually a museum, and as such, it has strict rules about what can be brought inside, including restrictions on the number of items allowed.

translations.source: A ka nwere ọtụtụ ndị dị ndụ taa lanarịrị oge ha nọrọ ebe a, na ọtụtụ ndị ọzọ ndị nwere ndị ha hụrụ n'anya ndị e gburu ma ọ bụ jiri ọrụ gbuo ha ebe ahụ, ma Ndị Juu ma ndị ọzọ na-abụghị Ndị Juu.
translations.reference: There are still many men and women alive who survived their time here, and many more who had loved ones who were murdered or worked to death there, Jews and non-Jews alike.
translations.hypothesis: Many people are still alive today who lived through that time, and many others who lost loved ones, both Jewish and non-Jewish, during that period.

translations.source: Biko kwanyere webụsaịt a ugwu niile dịịrị ya. Ejila Họlọkọst maọbụ ndị Nazi eme ihe ụka ọchị.
translations.reference: Please treat the site with all of the dignity, solemnity and respect it deserves. Do not make jokes about the Holocaust or Nazis.
translations.hypothesis: Please respect this website and its content. Do not use the Holocaust or Nazis as a source of humor.

translations.source: Emebila saịtị ahụ site n'ise akara maọbụ ịkanye grafiti n'ime ihe ndi owuwu.
translations.reference: Do not deface the site by marking or scratching graffiti into structures.
translations.hypothesis: You can create the design by using five symbols or by incorporating graffiti into the artwork.

translations.source: Ụmụ isi asụsụ nke Baselona bụ Katalan na Spanish. Ihe dị ka ọkara kara chọọ ịsụ Katalan, imirikiti na-aghọta ya, ma onye niile kendịnuche mara Spanish.
translations.reference: Barcelona's official languages are Catalan and Spanish. About a half prefer to speak Catalan, a vast majority understands it, and virtually everyone knows Spanish.
translations.hypothesis: The official languages of Barcelona are Catalan and Spanish. Approximately half the population prefers to speak Catalan, most people understand it, but everyone speaks Spanish.

translations.source: Ma otu-osi-di, ihe-ngosi ka n’onu ogugu ka egosiri na asusu Catalan nani n’ihi na eguzosiri ya ike n’iwu dika asusu nke bu nke obodo.
translations.reference: However, most signs are indicated only in Catalan because it is established by law as the first official language.
translations.hypothesis: However, the exhibition, as presented in the Catalan language, was only accessible to those who understood Catalan, as it was primarily designed as a cultural offering for the local community.

translations.source: Ma, a na-ejikwa asụsụ ndị Spenụ njem ọha ebe ọ dị ukwuu nakwa akụrụngwa ndị ọzọ.
translations.reference: Yet, Spanish is also widely used in public transport and other facilities.
translations.hypothesis: However, Spanish is also widely used in public transportation and other services.

translations.source: A na-ama ọkwa mgbedum na Metro naanị na asụsụ Catalan, mana mmesasị nke a na-emeghị atụmatụ ya bụ ndị a na-ekwuputa site na sistemụ akpaghị aka n'ọtụtụ asụsụ dịgasị iche iche gụnyere Spanish, English, French, Arabic na Japanese.
translations.reference: Regular announcements in the Metro are made only in Catalan, but unplanned disruptions are announced by an automated system in a wide variety of languages including Spanish, English, French, Arabic and Japanese.
translations.hypothesis: While the announcements on the Metro system are primarily in Catalan, a surprising feature is that information is also provided through an automated system in several other languages, including Spanish, English, French, Arabic, and Japanese.

translations.source: Ndi Parisi nwere aha imaara isi, nganga na mpako.
translations.reference: Parisians have a reputation for being egocentric, rude and arrogant.
translations.hypothesis: Politicians are known for their ambition, cunning, and ruthlessness.

translations.source: Mgbe nke a na-abụkarị naanị nhụnuche na-ezighị ezi, ụzọ kachasị mma iji na-aga n’ihu n’ime Parii bụ na ị nọ n’omume gị kachasị mma, na-eme ka onye bụ "bien élevé" (a zụrụ nke ọma). Ọ ga-eme ka ngagharị n’ebe ahụ kara dị mfe.
translations.reference: While this is often only an inaccurate stereotype, the best way to get along in Paris still is to be on your best behavior, acting like someone who is "bien élevé" (well brought up). It will make getting about considerably easier.
translations.hypothesis: Often, what seems like a simple misunderstanding can be easily resolved. The best way to navigate social situations in Paris is to be on your best behavior and act with good manners, embodying the idea of being "bien élevé" (well-bred). This will make your interactions much smoother.
