translations.source: Agwa ọjọọ Ndị Pari ga-akwụsị ọsịịsọ ma ọ bụrụ na i gosi ụfọdụ nruweisi nkịtị.
translations.reference: Parisians' abrupt exteriors will rapidly evaporate if you display some basic courtesies.
translations.hypothesis: The behavior of the judges will be scrutinized, and they may face consequences if they exhibit any signs of bias.

translations.source: Ebe nnọkọọha mba nke Ụmụ ndọrọ mmiri Plitvice nwere oke ọhịa, nwejuru ụmụ osisi beech, spruce, na fir, ma nweekwa mwụkọta nke Alpine na ahịhịa Mediterranean.
translations.reference: The Plitvice Lakes national park is heavily forested, mainly with beech, spruce, and fir trees, and features a mixture of Alpine and Mediterranean vegetation.
translations.hypothesis: The Plitvice Lakes National Park is characterized by its dense forests, featuring beech, spruce, and fir trees, and also includes a variety of Alpine and Mediterranean flora.

translations.source: Onwere otutu osisi ama ama, maka ebea nwere klimeti di icheiche, aja ya di iche iche, altitude ya dikwa iche n’iche.
translations.reference: It has a notably wide variety of plant communities, due to its range of microclimates, differing soils and varying levels of altitude.
translations.hypothesis: There are many famous trees, as the climate, soil, and altitude vary greatly in different regions.

translations.source: Ebe a bụkwa ebe obibi nye ọtụtụ ụdị dị iche iche nke ụdị ụmụ anụmanụ na ụmụ nnụnnụ.
translations.reference: The area is also home to an extremely wide variety of animal and bird species.
translations.hypothesis: This area is also home to a variety of different species of animals and birds.

translations.source: Ụmụ anụmanụ nke ebe obibi pụrụ iche nke anaghị ahụkarị dị ka anụ ọhịa bea ndị Yurop na-acha uri, agụ owulu, ugo, ikwiikwii, nwamba oke ọhịa linz, e nwere ike ịhụ nwamba oke ọhịa na eruru, ya na ọtụtụ ụdị ndị ọzọ a na-ahụkarị.
translations.reference: Rare fauna such as the European brown bear, wolf, eagle, owl, lynx, wild cat and capercaillie can be found there, along with many more common species
translations.hypothesis: The unique habitat supports a variety of wildlife, including European hedgehogs, owls, eagles, squirrels, and wild boars. You can also find deer, foxes, and a number of other common species.

translations.source: Ụmụ nwanyị na-aga na monastrị ga-eyi sket na-ekpuchi ikpere ha ma mechiekwa ubu ha.
translations.reference: While visiting the monasteries, women are required to wear skirts covering the knees and have their shoulders covered, too.
translations.hypothesis: Women who visit the monastery should wear skirts that cover their knees and keep their shoulders covered.

translations.source: Ọtụtụ n'ime ebe obibi ndị mọnk na-enye akwa mkpuchi maka ụmụ nwanyị ndị bịara na-adịghị njikere, mana ọ bụrụ na ị weta nke gị, tụmadị nke nwere agba chapụrụ achapụ, ị ga enweta otu mmụmụ ọnụ ọchị sitere na mọnk ma ọ bụ nọn nọ n'ọnụ ụzọ ahụ.
translations.reference: Most of the monasteries do provide wraps for women who come unprepared, but if you bring your own, especially one with bright colors, you'll get a smile from the monk or nun at the entrance.
translations.hypothesis: Many of the monasteries provide robes for women who visit and are not properly dressed, but if you bring your own, especially one with a bright color, you are likely to receive a disapproving look from the monk or someone at the entrance.

translations.source: N'otu ụzọ ahụ, a chọrọ ka ụmụ nwoke na-eyi ụmụ traụza na-ekpuchi ikpere.
translations.reference: Along the same line, men are required to wear trousers covering the knees.
translations.hypothesis: Similarly, boys were required to wear trousers that covered their knees.

translations.source: E nwere ike ịgbaziri nke a kwa site n'akwa ndị nọ n'ọnụ ụzọ mana anaghị asa akwa ahụ ma mmadụ yichaa ya mere ị nwere ike ị gaghị enwe ahụ iru ala iyi sket ndị a. Otu nha na-adaba ụmụ nwoke niile!
translations.reference: This too can be borrowed from the stock at the entrance but that clothing isn't washed after every user so you may not feel comfortable wearing these skirts. One size fits all for men!
translations.hypothesis: You can also adjust the fit by tightening the drawstrings at the waist, but avoid pulling them too tight to prevent discomfort. One size fits most men!

translations.source: Nri ndị Majorca, dị ka nke ndị mpaghara ndị yiri ya n'ime Mediterranean, na-adabere n'achịcha, akwụkwọ nri na anụ (tụmadị anụ ezi), ma na-eji mmanụ oliv mgbe niile.
translations.reference: Majorcan cuisine, like that of similar zones in the Mediterranean, is based on bread, vegetables and meat (specially pork), and uses olive oil throughout.
translations.hypothesis: The cuisine of Majorca, like that of other Mediterranean regions, is based on fresh produce, vegetables, and meat (especially pork), and it always uses olive oil.

translations.source: Pa amb Oli bụ nri abalị dị mfe nke amaara ọkachasị n'oge sọma: Achịcha na mmanụ oliv, tomato, na ụmụ orishirishi ndị ọzọ dị adị dịka chiizi, azụ tuna, dzg.
translations.reference: A simple popular dinner, especially during the summer, is the Pa amb Oli: Bread with olive oil, tomato, and any available condiments such as cheese, tunafish, etc.
translations.hypothesis: Pa amb oli is a simple, flavorful dish often enjoyed for dinner, particularly during the summer months. It typically consists of pasta, olive oil, tomatoes, and other ingredients such as cheese, tuna, or vegetables.

translations.source: Aha niile, tinyere okwu Sie maka gị, na-ebidokarị n’iji mkpụrụ edemede ukwu, ọbụnadị n’etiti ahịrịokwu.
translations.reference: All nouns, alongside the word Sie for you, always begin with a capital letter, even in the middle of a sentence.
translations.hypothesis: All names, including titles and honorifics, should be capitalized, even within a sentence.

translations.source: Ụzọ a bụ ụzọ dị mkpa e si amata ihe dị iche n’etiti ụfọdụ ngwaa na nnara.
translations.reference: This is an important way to distinguish between some verbs and objects.
translations.hypothesis: This method is a crucial way to distinguish between certain types of plants and animals.

translations.source: Ọ na-emekwa ka ọgụgụ dị mfe karịa, mana edemede bịara ratụ ahụ maka aghaghị ịmara ma ngwaa maọbụ nkọwa aha ọbụla ọ bụ mpụta ahịrịokwu ahụ.
translations.reference: It also arguably makes reading easier, though writing is somewhat complicated by the need to find out whether a verb or adjective is used in a substantivized form.
translations.hypothesis: While it makes the text easier to read, the excessive use of bolding can become distracting and it's not always clear whether a word or phrase is bolded for emphasis or because it's a proper noun or part of a specific term.

translations.source: Mkpọpụta okwu dịtụ mfe n' Ịtalịan ebe ọtụtụ mkpụrụokwu bụ ndị a na-akpọpụta kpọmkwen etu esi dee ha
translations.reference: Pronunciation is relatively easy in Italian since most words are pronounced exactly how they are written
translations.hypothesis: Italian grammar can be relatively straightforward because many words have clear and consistent rules for how they are spelled.

translations.source: Ụmụ isi mkpụrụabịdịị ndị a ga-elesi anya maka bụ c na g, ebe mkpọpụta ha na-adị iche na-ndabere na ụdaume na-esote.
translations.reference: The main letters to watch out for are c and g, since their pronunciation varies based on the following vowel.
translations.hypothesis: The following special characters should be noted: 'c' and 'g', as their pronunciation may vary depending on the following sound.

translations.source: Jisiekwa ike hụ na ị kpọpụtara r na rr n'ụzọ dị iche. caro pụtara ezigbo, ebe carro pụtara ụgbọ ịnyịnya.
translations.reference: Also, make sure to pronounce r and rr differently: caro means dear, whereas carro means chariot.
translations.hypothesis: Please ensure that you differentiate between the two words. "Caro" means "car," while "carro" means "truck."

translations.source: Asụsụ Peshịa nwere ụtọasụsụ kacha dị mfe ma bụrụ nke a kacha agbaso.
translations.reference: Persian has a relatively easy and mostly regular grammar.
translations.hypothesis: Persian is considered one of the easiest languages to learn and one of the most widely spoken.

translations.source: Ya bu igu akwukwo uto asusu ga enyere gi aka imuta maka uto asusu Persia makwa ghota ahiriokwu ofuma.
translations.reference: Therefore, reading this grammar primer would help you learn much about Persian grammar and understand phrases better.
translations.hypothesis: This is a helpful guide to Persian grammar that will assist you in understanding the intricacies of the language.

translations.source: Ọ baghị uru ikwu, ọ bụrụ na ị mara otu asụsụ Ịhụnanya, ọ ga-adịtụ mfe ịmụta asụsụ Pọtụgiiz.
translations.reference: Needless to say, if you know a Romance language, it will be easier for you to learn Portuguese.
translations.hypothesis: It's true that if you know the Igbo language, it will be easier to learn Portuguese.

translations.source: Agbanyeghi, ndị mara asụsụ Spenụ obere nwere ike ikpebi ọsịịsọ na ya na asụsụ Pọtugiizi yrir nke ọma na o kwesịghị ka a mụọ ya n’iche.
translations.reference: However, people who know a little Spanish may hastily conclude that Portuguese is close enough that it need not be studied separately.
translations.hypothesis: However, even those who speak a little Spanish may find it difficult to understand Portuguese, and it is not always easy to learn.

translations.source: Ọbzavetrị ndị oge gara aga anaghị abachazi uru taa; e jizi ha eme ụlọ ndokwa ihe nka maọbụ ebe mmụta.
translations.reference: Pre-modern observatories are usually obsolete today, and remain as museums, or sites of education.
translations.hypothesis: Vintage items still hold value today; they can be used as artistic decorations or as educational tools.

translations.source: Dị ka mmetọ keọkụ n'isimbụ ha abụghị ụdị nsogbu ọ bụ ugbu a, a na-ahụkarị ha n'ime obodo ma ọ bụ na kampọs, nke dị mfe irute karịa ndị ahụ arụrụ n'oge ugbu a.
translations.reference: As light pollution in their heyday was not the kind of problem it is today, they are usually located in cities or at campuses, easier to reach than those built in modern times.
translations.hypothesis: While petty thefts may not be a major problem currently, they are frequently encountered within towns or on campuses, making them easier to address than more serious crimes.

translations.source: Otutu teliskop eji eme resaach n'oge ugbu a bu nnukwu ulo oru di n'ebe dipuru adipu nwere ezigbo ihu igwe.
translations.reference: Most modern research telescopes are enormous facilities in remote areas with favorable atmospheric conditions.
translations.hypothesis: Modern telescopes used for research are large, complex instruments designed to provide clear views of the night sky.

translations.source: Nlere ifuru Cheri, nke a maara dị ka hanami, bụ omenala na Japan kemgbe nari afọ nke 8.
translations.reference: Cherry blossom viewing, known as hanami, has been a part of Japanese culture since the 8th century.
translations.hypothesis: Cherry blossom viewing, also known as "hanami," is a tradition in Japan that dates back to the 8th century.

translations.source: Echiche ahụ sitere na mba Chaịna bịa ebe plum blossom bụ okooko kacha amasị.
translations.reference: The concept came from China where plum blossoms were the flower of choice.
translations.hypothesis: The idea originated from China, where the plum blossom is the most beloved flower.

translations.source: Na Japan, Onye eze Emperọ haziri mmemme mkpụrụ osisi cheri izizi maka naanị ya na ndị otu ndị ọzọ na-ahụ maka ọchịchị Ụlọ ikpe etiti.
translations.reference: In Japan, the first cherry blossom parties were hosted by the emperor only for himself and other members of the aristocracy around the Imperial Court.
translations.hypothesis: In Japan, the Emperor held a private tea ceremony exclusively for himself and a select group of officials from the Supreme Court.

translations.source: Ụmụ akụmakụ na-adị n'ụdị ha kacha mma mgbe ha nọ na gburugburu ebe obibi ekere, ya mere gbochie ọnwụnwa iwepụ ọbụna "naanị otu" ihe nlere.
translations.reference: Plants look their best when in a natural environment, so resist the temptation to remove even "just one" specimen.
translations.hypothesis: Plants thrive best when they are in their ideal environment, so avoid removing even a single "test" item.

translations.source: Ọ bụrụ na ị na-eleta otu ubi ahazigoro etu o kwesịrị, ị na-ewere "ụmụ ihe nlere" ga-eme ka a chụpụ gị, na-emeghị mkparịta ụka.
translations.reference: If visiting a formally arranged garden, collecting "specimens" is also going to get you ejected, without discussion.
translations.hypothesis: If you are visiting a well-organized event, bringing "uninvited guests" will likely cause you to be asked to leave, without any discussion.

translations.source: Singapore bu kwanu ebe di mma ino makwa igaghari ma inwere ike igote ihe o bula i choro ma irute.
translations.reference: Singapore is generally an extremely safe place to be and very easy to navigate, and you can buy almost anything after arriving.
translations.hypothesis: Singapore is a wonderful place to visit, where you can find everything you need and more.

translations.source: Mana ị na-edobe gị n'ime "ebe ndị na-ekpo oke ọkụ" ị ga-achọ naanị digiri ole na ole n'ugwu nke ikwuetọ imeso ma ekpomọkụ (mgbe niile) ma anwụ siri ike (mgbe elu igwe kpochara ekpocha, nke kara raa ahụ omume).
translations.reference: But being placed in the "high tropics" just a few degrees north of equator you will need to deal with both heat (always) and strong sun (when the sky is clear, more rarely).
translations.hypothesis: However, if you are staying in a "hot and humid" environment, you will only need a few degrees of incline on the fan to provide a cooling breeze (especially when the humidity is high, which can make the heat feel even more intense).

translations.source: E nwekwara ụfọdụ burumbu na-aga mgbago ugwu ruo Hebrọn, ebe ọdịnala e liri ndị nnaochie nke akwụkwọ nso bụ Ebraham, Aịzik, Jekọb, na ndị nwunye ha.
translations.reference: There are also a few buses going north to Hebron, the traditional burial place of the Biblical patriarchs Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and their wives.
translations.hypothesis: There were also certain caravans that traveled to the mountains of Hebron, where the patriarchs of the scriptures, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, and their wives, were revered.

translations.source: Lelee na bọọsụ ị na-eche maka ịbanye na ya na-aga Hebron ma ọ bụghị naanị na ebe obibi ndị Juu nke Kiryat Arba dị nso.
translations.reference: Check that the bus you are thinking of taking goes into Hebron and not just to the nearby Jewish settlement of Kiryat Arba.
translations.hypothesis: Please note that the bus you are considering taking is going to Hebron, and it also stops near the Jewish settlement of Kiryat Arba.

translations.source: Ụzọ mmiri ndị ime obodo nwere ike ịbụ ezigbo isiokwu iji hazie oge ezumike.
translations.reference: Inland waterways can be a good theme to base a holiday around.
translations.hypothesis: City water systems can be a fascinating topic to explore during the holidays.

translations.source: Maka ọmụmatụ ileta ụmụ nnukwu ụlọ n’ime Ndagwurugwu Loire, Ndagwurugwu Rhine ma ọ bụ ime njem ụgbọ mmiri gaa obodo ndị na-adọrọ mmasị n’ime Danube ahụ ma ọ bụ ịgba ụgbọ mmiri n’ogologo ụzọ Kanaal Erie ahụ.
translations.reference: For example visiting castles in the Loire Valley, the Rhine valley or taking a cruise to interesting cites on the Danube or boating along the Erie Canal.
translations.hypothesis: For example, you could take a trip to visit castles in the Loire Valley, explore the Rhine region, or take a river cruise to interesting towns along the Danube, or even travel the length of the Erie Canal.

translations.source: Ha na akọwapụtakwa ụmụ ụzọ a ga-eso maka ụzọ haịkịnụ na ọghụgha igwe ama ama.
translations.reference: They also define routes for popular hiking and cycling trails.
translations.hypothesis: These students were also recognized for their outstanding performance in mathematics and their contributions to the school's science fair.

translations.source: Ekeresimesi bụ otu n’ime ezumike kachasị mkpa nke Ndị na-eso Ụzọ Kraịst, ma a na-eme ememme ya dị ka ncheta omumu Jizos.
translations.reference: Christmas is one of the most important holidays of Christianity, and is celebrated as the birthday of Jesus.
translations.hypothesis: Christmas is one of the most important holidays for Christians, and it is celebrated as a commemoration of Jesus' birth.

translations.source: Ndi na-ekweghi na Chukwu na mba ndi otu Kristi gasi ma ndi n’abughi ndi otu Kristi n’uwa niile anabatago otutu odinala enwere maka oge ezumike.
translations.reference: Many of the traditions surrounding the holiday have been adopted also by non-believers in Christian countries and non-Christians around the world.
translations.hypothesis: People who do not believe in God, as well as those who are not part of Christian denominations, and those of other faiths around the world, observe various holidays and celebrations.

translations.source: Enwere ọdịnala maka ịmụ anya n'abalị Ista n'ebe mepere emepe iji hụ ọwụwa anyanwụ.
translations.reference: There's a tradition to pass the Easter night awake at some exposed point to see the sunrise.
translations.hypothesis: There is a tradition of staying up all night on the eve of the Feast of the Nativity to watch the sunrise.

translations.source: Enwere n'ezie nkọwa na nkà mmụta okpukpe nke Ndị Kraịst maka ọdịnala a, mana ọ nwere ike bụrụ emume ọmụmụ tupu nchụaja Oge mmiri na Ọmụmụ nwa Ndị Kristi abịa.
translations.reference: There are of course Christian theological explanations for this tradition, but it may well be a pre-Christian Spring and Fertility ritual.
translations.hypothesis: While there are indeed theological interpretations and understandings within Christianity regarding this tradition, it could also be seen as a pre-Christian celebration that predates the Christian observances of Christmas and the birth of Christ.

translations.source: Ọtụtụ ụlọụka agba ochie na-amụkarị anya abalị Ista n'abalị Satọde n'oge ngwụcha izu Ista, ebe ndị ụka na-abanye na mmemme ma ọ kụọ elekere abụọ nke etiti abalị iji mee mmemme mbilite n'ọnwụ Kraịstị.
translations.reference: More traditional churches often hold an Easter Vigil on Saturday night during the Easter weekend, with the congregations often breaking into celebration at the stroke of midnight to celebrate Christ's resurrection.
translations.hypothesis: Many traditional churches hold vigil services on Saturday nights, often culminating in a two-hour ceremony held around midnight to commemorate the death of Christ.

translations.source: Ụmụ anụmanụ niile ndị nke bịarutere n’ime agwaetiti ndị ahụ bịarutere ebe a site n’igwu mmiri, ife efe ma ọ bụ ise n’elu mmiri.
translations.reference: All animals that originally arrived in the islands came here either by swimming, flying or floating.
translations.hypothesis: All the animals that arrived on those islands came there by swimming, flying, or floating on the water.

translations.source: N'ihi ogologo ntoanya site na kọntinentị ahụ ụmụ anụ na-an̄ụ ara enwenwughị ike ịga njem ahụ ya mere na-eme nnukwu mbe isi anụmanụ na-ata ahịhịa n'ime Galapagos ahụ.
translations.reference: Due to the long distance from the continent mammals were unable to make the journey making the giant tortoise the primary grazing animal in the Galapagos.
translations.hypothesis: Due to the vast distance from the mainland, the animals of the Galapagos Islands have not been able to migrate, resulting in a unique ecosystem with many endemic species.

translations.source: Ke,gbe mbịarute nke mmadụ na Galapagos, ewebatala ọtụtụ anụ na-an̄ụ ara gụnyere ewu, inyinya, ehi, oke, nwamba na nkịta.
translations.reference: Since the arrival of man to the Galapagos, many mammals have been introduced including goats, horses, cows, rats, cats and dogs.
translations.hypothesis: In the Galapagos Islands, a human-introduced invasive species has led to the establishment of several non-native animals, including pigs, goats, donkeys, cats, rats, and dogs.

translations.source: Ọ bụrụ na ị leta ụmụ ebe Aktik ma ọ bụ Antatik n'ime oge oyi ị ga-enwe ahụmihe nke abalị pola, nke pụtara na anyanwụ agaghị awa na horaịzọn ahụ.
translations.reference: If you visit the Arctic or Antarctic areas in the winter you will experience the polar night, which means that the sun doesn't rise above the horizon.
translations.hypothesis: If you visit the Arctic or Antarctic regions during the winter, you will experience the polar night, which means that the sun will not rise above the horizon.

translations.source: Nke a na-enye ezigbo ohere iji hụ Aurora borealis, dị ka eluigwe ga-agba itiri karịa ma ọ bụ obere gburugburu elekerea ahụ.
translations.reference: This offers a good opportunity to see the Aurora borealis, as the sky will be dark more or less around the clock.
translations.hypothesis: This offers a great opportunity to see the Aurora Borealis, as the sky will be darker or have less light pollution.

translations.source: Dika ebe ndị ahụ bụ ebe ndị mmadụ ebichabeghị etu ahụ, na mmetọ nke ọkụ ya mere anaghị abụkarị nsogbu, ị ga-enwekwa ike ịnụ ụtọ ụmụ kpakpando.
translations.reference: As the areas are sparsely populated, and light pollution therefore often not a problem, you will also be able to enjoy the stars.
translations.hypothesis: Since these are areas where people don't typically live, and the lack of light isn't usually a problem, you can enjoy the beauty of the stars.

translations.source: Omenala ọrụ ndị Japan nwere ogugo na iwu dị iche iche karịa ihe ndị ọdịda anyanwụ maara.
translations.reference: Japanese work culture is more hierarchical and formal that what Westerners may be used to.
translations.hypothesis: Japanese work culture has different values and rules compared to what is commonly known in Western cultures.

translations.source: Suutu uwe azụmaahịa izugbe, ma ndị ọrụ ibe na-akpọ onye ọ bụla site n'aha ezinụlọ ha ma ọ bụ site n'aha ọrụ ha.
translations.reference: Suits are standard business attire, and coworkers call each other by their family names or by job titles.
translations.hypothesis: In a formal business setting, colleagues typically address each other by their last name or by their job title.

translations.source: Nkwekorita nke ebe oru di nkpa, na-ekwusi ike na mbọ otu karịa ito ụmụ mmezu nke otu onye.
translations.reference: Workplace harmony is crucial, emphasizing group effort rather than praising individual accomplishments.
translations.hypothesis: Collaboration in the workplace is crucial, emphasizing teamwork over individual achievement.

translations.source: Ndi oru kwesiri inweta nkwado onye isi ha maka mkpebi obula ha ga ekpebi, ha kwesikwara irube isi n’ozi o bula onye isi ha ziri ha n’ajughi ajuju.
translations.reference: Workers must often get their superiors' approval for any decisions they make, and are expected to obey their superiors' instructions without question.
translations.hypothesis: Employees should receive the approval of their superiors for every decision they make, and they should also inform their superiors of any decisions they have made without being asked.
